title: AdvSim2Real : Training Web Agents Against Adaptive Prompt Injection in a Web World Model
title_zh: AdvSim2Real：在网页世界模型中对抗自适应提示注入的训练方法

paragraphs.en: Web agents complete user requests by reading and acting on pages that third parties write, so an instruction planted on a page can redirect the agent away from the user’s goal. The agent cannot simply ignore the page, because the page also holds the values and controls the task requires. Current defenses fine-tune the agent on injections fixed before training, and attackers that adapt to the trained model bypass them. Adversarial training lets the attacker adapt but keeps the tasks fixed, so a task stops teaching once the agent solves it. We introduce AdvSim2Real, which co-evolves a task curriculum, an injection adversary, and the agent inside a frozen web world model. The curriculum is rewarded for tasks the agent solves about half of the time, and the adversary only for a success flip, an injection that turns a judged success into a failure. Training in the simulator makes a 4B agent both more capable and more robust: its completion rises with and without attacks, holds against a frontier-model adversary it never trained against, and its capability gain carries over to a real browser. On 150 web tasks, AdvSim2Real raises completion under this unseen adversary by 33.6% relative to the base agent.We release our code , the benchmark, and all checkpoint results .
paragraphs.zh: 网络智能体通过阅读并操作第三方编写的页面来完成用户请求，因此植入页面的指令可能会将智能体引离用户的真实目标。智能体无法简单地忽略该页面，因为页面还包含任务所需的数值和控制信息。当前的防御方法通过在训练前固定的注入样本对智能体进行微调，但能够适应已训练模型的攻击者却能绕过这些防御。对抗性训练允许攻击者进行适应，但保持任务不变，因此一旦智能体解决某个任务，该任务便停止提供学习价值。我们提出了 AdvSim2Real 方法，该方法在冻结的网络世界模型中协同演化任务课程、注入对抗样本以及智能体本身。任务课程会根据智能体约一半时间能成功完成的任务获得奖励，而对抗样本则仅在发生“成功翻转”时获得奖励——即注入样本将原本被判定为成功的结果转变为失败。在模拟器中进行训练使一个 4B 智能体既更强大也更具备鲁棒性：无论是否存在攻击，其任务完成率均有所提升；面对从未训练过的前沿模型级对抗样本时，它仍能保持稳定；其能力提升效果还能迁移到真实浏览器中。在 150 个网络任务上，与基础智能体相比，AdvSim2Real 在面对这一未知对抗样本时的任务完成率提升了 33.6%。我们公开了代码、基准测试以及所有检查点结果。

paragraphs.en: Web agents now complete multi-step requests on websites, such as updating a customer record from the entries a page displays ( Zhou et al., 2024 ; Qi et al., 2025 ; Xi et al., 2025 ) . The web differs from other tool settings because every page is written by a third party and mixes the data a task needs with the controls that act on it. An instruction planted in page content can therefore redirect the agent away from the user’s request, an attack known as indirect prompt injection ( Greshake et al., 2023 ) , and on a web-agent security benchmark such attacks partially succeed in up to 86% of cases ( Evtimov et al., 2025 ) . The agent cannot defend itself by ignoring the page, because the page also holds the values and controls the task requires. A provider therefore needs task-preserving robustness : the agent completes its authorized goal despite competing page instructions whenever the task remains feasible.
paragraphs.zh: 网络智能体如今能够在网站上完成多步骤请求，例如根据页面显示的信息更新客户记录（Zhou 等人，2024；Qi 等人，2025；Xi 等人，2025）。网络与其他工具环境不同，因为每个页面都由第三方编写，并将任务所需的数据与用于操作这些数据控件混合在一起。因此，嵌入在页面内容中的指令可能会将智能体引离用户的请求，这种攻击被称为间接提示注入（Greshake 等人，2023）；在网络智能体安全基准测试中，此类攻击的成功率最高可达 86%（Evtimov 等人，2025）。智能体无法通过忽略页面来自我防御，因为页面也包含了任务所需的值和控制项。因此，提供者需要具备任务保留的鲁棒性：只要任务仍然可行，智能体就必须无视页面中的干扰指令，完成其授权的目标。

paragraphs.en: Current defenses fine-tune the agent on injected examples built before training, in some cases with a delimiter-based input format, so that it follows the user and disregards the planted instruction ( Wallace et al., 2024 ; Chen et al., 2025a ; Chen et al., 2025b ; Chen et al., 2025c ) . Because these injections never change, the defender never meets an attacker that adapts to it, and attackers that optimize against the trained model bypass StruQ and Meta SecAlign ( Nasr et al., 2026 ) . Recent work therefore trains the attacker as well: RETA red-teams a frozen agent and trains the defender on the recorded attacks ( He et al., 2026 ) , while ARLAS, DMAST, and CoER co-train an attacker and an agent in executed tool or browser environments ( Wang et al., 2025c ; Liu et al., 2026a ; Zhang et al., 2026 ) . These methods adapt the attacks but keep the training tasks fixed, so a task stops teaching once the agent solves it, and each new task requires a site that can execute it.
paragraphs.zh: 当前的防御方法通过在训练前构建的注入示例上对智能体进行微调，有时还采用基于分隔符的输入格式，使其遵循用户指令而忽略植入的指示（Wallace 等人，2024；Chen 等人，2025a；Chen 等人，2025b；Chen 等人，2025c）。由于这些注入示例从未改变，防御方从未遇到过能够适应它们的攻击者，而那些针对训练模型进行优化的攻击者则会绕过 StruQ 和 Meta SecAlign（Nasr 等人，2026）。因此，近期的研究也开始对攻击者进行训练：RETA 会对一个冻结的智能体进行红队测试，并基于记录下来的攻击对防御方进行训练（He 等人，2026）；而 ARLAS、DMAST 和 CoER 则会在执行工具或浏览器环境中对攻击者和智能体进行联合训练（Wang 等人，2025c；Liu 等人，2026a；Zhang 等人，2026）。这些方法虽然能够调整攻击策略，但保留了固定的训练任务，因此一旦智能体解决某个任务，该任务便停止提供教学信息，而每个新任务都需要一个能够执行该任务的站点。

paragraphs.en: A web world model removes both limits, because it predicts the next page for any goal, page, and action, including a page that an adversary asks it to alter ( Xiao et al., 2026 ) . We use this to introduce AdvSim2Real , which trains three policies against one another inside a frozen world model: a curriculum that writes tasks as a goal and an initial page, an adversary that requests one injection per trajectory, and the web agent, which we call the executor , as Figure 1 shows. The curriculum is rewarded for tasks the current executor solves about half of the time, as graded by a fixed language-model judge. The adversary is rewarded only for a success flip : a clean run that the judge accepted is replayed to the chosen step, the injection is rendered there, and the adversary earns credit only if the continuation fails.
paragraphs.zh: 网络世界模型消除了这两种限制，因为它能够针对任何目标、页面和操作预测下一个页面，包括对手要求它修改的页面（Xiao 等人，2026）。我们利用这一点引入了 AdvSim2Real，该方法在一个冻结的世界模型内部训练三种相互对抗的策略：一种将任务作为目标和初始页面编写的课程策略、一个每次轨迹仅请求一次注入的对手策略，以及我们称之为执行者的网络智能体，如图 1 所示。课程策略的奖励取决于当前执行者解决的任务比例——大约一半的任务能够获得奖励，这一评估由一个固定的语言模型裁判完成。而对手策略只有在成功翻转时才能获得奖励：即当裁判接受了一次干净的运行后，将运行重放到所选步骤，在此处执行注入操作；如果后续流程因此失败，对手策略才能获得奖励。

paragraphs.en: AdvSim2Real runs in two stages. In the first, the curriculum and the executor alternate updates, so the tasks follow the executor’s competence. In the second, the curriculum is frozen and the adversary and the executor alternate, and the executor trains on clean tasks, new attacks, and the attacks of earlier rounds.
paragraphs.zh: AdvSim2Real 分两个阶段运行。在第一阶段，课程和智能体交替更新，因此任务会跟随智能体的能力进行调整。在第二阶段，课程被固定下来，对抗方和智能体交替进行，而智能体则在干净的任务、新的攻击以及早期轮次的攻击上进行训练。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate a Qwen3.5-4B executor on the 150 web tasks of our benchmark in the frozen WebWorld-14B world model; fifty of them are close variants of eight parent tasks. Figure 2 shows a typical attack: an injected notice orders the agent to click a forbidden reset button, the base agent obeys and fails, and the trained executor completes the same task. AdvSim2Real raises clean completion from 74.89% to 81.33% and completion under the three learned adversaries from 48.07% to 57.48% ( Table 1 ). Against Kimi-K3 , a frontier model that took no part in training, completion rises from 23.00% to 30.72%, a 33.6% relative gain ( Table 3 ). all attacked results are measured inside the world model, where injections are rendered in the context of the page (Section 3 ) The capability gain of the first stage carries over to a real browser, where strict success on the submitted form rises from 25.56% to 44.44% without any world-model call ( Table 2 ).
paragraphs.zh: 我们在冻结的 WebWorld-14B 世界模型中，使用 Qwen3.5-4B 执行器对我们的基准测试中的 150 个网页任务进行了评估；其中五十项任务是八个基础任务的近变体。图 2 展示了一次典型的攻击：注入的通知命令智能体点击一个被禁止的重置按钮，基础智能体服从了该命令并失败，而训练后的执行器则成功完成了同一任务。AdvSim2Real 将干净完成率从 74.89% 提升至 81.33%，在三种已学习对抗样本下的完成率则从 48.07% 提升至 57.48%（表 1）。面对 Kimi-K3——一个未参与训练的顶尖模型——完成率从 23.00% 提升至 30.72%，相对增益达 33.6%（表 3）。所有受攻击的结果均在世界模型内部测量，其中注入内容是在页面上下文中呈现的（第 3 节）。第一阶段的能力提升也延续到了真实浏览器中：在没有调用任何世界模型的情况下，提交表单的成功率从 25.56% 提升至 44.44%（表 2）。

paragraphs.en: AdvSim2Real , a two-stage framework that co-evolves a task curriculum, an injection adversary, and a web agent inside a frozen web world model, so that both tasks and attacks track the current agent.
paragraphs.zh: AdvSim2Real 是一种两阶段框架，它在一个冻结的网页世界模型内部协同演化任务课程、注入对抗者和一个网页智能体，从而使得任务和攻击都能跟踪当前的智能体。

paragraphs.en: The success-flip reward, which replays an accepted clean run to the injection step and credits the adversary only when the continuation fails, so that failures the agent makes on its own earn nothing.
paragraphs.zh: 成功翻转奖励机制会重播一次已通过的干净运行至注入步骤，并且仅在后续过程失败时才会给予对抗方奖励，这样智能体自身造成的失败则不会获得任何奖励。

paragraphs.en: A benchmark of 150 form-filling web tasks in five skill strata, with protected fields and forbidden controls, a reactive adversary that chooses when and what to inject, and a deterministic browser check of the submitted form; we release it with all checkpoints and trajectories.
paragraphs.zh: 我们发布了一项基准测试，包含五个技能层级中的 150 个表单填写类网页任务，其中设有受保护字段和禁止操作的控制机制；测试中还包括一个反应型对抗方，它会决定何时注入何种内容，以及对提交表单进行确定性浏览器检查；同时，我们还一并发布了所有检查点和轨迹数据。

paragraphs.en: Evidence that the curriculum stage buys capability and the adversarial stage buys robustness: without the curriculum stage, the final agent loses 4.67 clean points but only 0.44 points of attacked completion ( Table 7 ).
paragraphs.zh: 证据表明，课程阶段能提升能力，而对抗阶段则能增强鲁棒性：如果没有课程阶段，最终智能体会损失 4.67 个干净样本得分，但被攻击后的完成度仅损失 0.44 分（表 7）。

paragraphs.en: Defenses trained on fixed injections. Indirect prompt injection places competing instructions in content that an agent reads while pursuing a trusted goal ( Greshake et al., 2023 ) . Most trained defenses learn from injections fixed before training: the instruction hierarchy trains a model to ignore lower-privileged instructions ( Wallace et al., 2024 ) , SecAlign and the open Meta SecAlign models prefer the response to the legitimate instruction over the response to the injection ( Chen et al., 2025b ; Chen et al., 2025c ) , and StruQ separates instructions from data with reserved delimiters ( Chen et al., 2025a ) . Because the injections never change, the defender first meets an adaptive attacker at evaluation, and attackers that optimize against the trained model bypass StruQ and Meta SecAlign ( Nasr et al., 2026 ; Wen et al., 2025 ) ; adaptive attacks also break detection, prompting, and paraphrasing defenses of tool agents ( Zhan et al., 2025 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 在固定注入样本上训练的防御方法。间接提示注入将相互冲突的指令嵌入到智能体在执行可信目标时读取的内容中（Greshake 等人，2023）。大多数经过训练的防御方法都从训练前已固定的注入样本中学习：指令层级法训练模型忽略权限较低的指令（Wallace 等人，2024）；SecAlign 和开源的 Meta SecAlign 模型则更倾向于对合法指令作出响应，而非对注入内容作出响应（Chen 等人，2025b；Chen 等人，2025c）；而 StruQ 则通过保留分隔符将指令与数据分离（Chen 等人，2025a）。由于注入样本从未改变，防御方直到评估阶段才会首次面对自适应攻击者，而那些针对训练模型进行优化的攻击者能够绕过 StruQ 和 Meta SecAlign（Nasr 等人，2026；Wen 等人，2025）；自适应攻击还会破坏工具智能体的检测、提示生成和改写类防御方法（Zhan 等人，2025）。

paragraphs.en: Adversarial training with a learning attacker. RETA adapts the attacker in one pass: a red-team policy trained against the frozen defender supplies the attacks on which the defender then trains ( He et al., 2026 ) . ARLAS co-trains an injection attacker and a tool-using agent as a zero-sum game, against every previous attacker checkpoint ( Wang et al., 2025c ) . CoER keeps populations of past policies of both roles and refines the defender on verified demonstrations ( Zhang et al., 2026 ) , and GPT-Red scales self-play to a red-teaming agent against simultaneously trained defenders ( Wallace et al., 2026 ) . Self-RedTeam and DMAST co-train attacker and defender by self-play, for chat safety and for a web agent facing DOM injections ( Liu et al., 2026b ; Liu et al., 2026a ) ; WARD co-evolves an attacker with a separate guard model for web agents ( Cao et al., 2026 ) , and ToolHazard synthesizes adversarial tool environments, attacks, and tasks ( Mou et al., 2026 ) . None of these adapts the training tasks to the current agent or trains inside a web world model; our work co-evolves the tasks with the attacker inside one ( Section D.5 ).
paragraphs.zh: 对抗性训练与学习型攻击者。RETA 在一次遍历中适配攻击者：一个针对冻结的防御者进行训练的红队策略，会提供防御者随后用于训练的攻击样本（He et al., 2026）。ARLAS 将注入攻击者与工具使用智能体作为零和博弈进行联合训练，以对抗此前每个攻击者的检查点（Wang et al., 2025c）。CoER 保留两个角色过去策略的种群，并基于经过验证的演示对防御者进行优化（Zhang et al., 2026）；GPT-Red 则将自对弈扩展至红队智能体，以对抗同步训练的防御者（Wallace et al., 2026）。Self-RedTeam 和 DMAST 通过自对弈联合训练攻击者与防御者，分别用于保障聊天安全性和应对 DOM 注入的网页智能体（Liu et al., 2026b；Liu et al., 2026a）；WARD 则为一个网页智能体单独演化攻击者与守护模型（Cao et al., 2026）；ToolHazard 则合成对抗性工具环境、攻击与任务（Mou et al., 2026）。这些方法均未将训练任务适配于当前智能体，也未在网页世界模型内部进行训练；而我们的工作则在一个世界模型内部，使任务与攻击者共同演化（D.5 节）。

paragraphs.en: Adaptive task generation. A fixed task set stops teaching once the policy solves it, so agents generate their own: WebRL derives new web tasks from failed attempts ( Qi et al., 2025 ) , SAGE grows a curriculum from easy to hard ( Yang et al., 2025 ) , and AgentGen evolves synthesized tasks toward easier and harder variants ( Hu et al., 2024 ) . PAE trains web agents on tasks from a context-aware proposer graded by a VLM evaluator ( Zhou et al., 2025b ) , Self-Challenging has one model write verifiable tasks and then solve them ( Zhou et al., 2025a ) , and R-Zero rewards a challenger for questions on which its solver agrees with itself about half the time ( Huang et al., 2026 ) . Agent0 alternates curriculum and executor updates ( Xia et al., 2025 ) , and GenEnv trains an environment policy toward intermediate agent success ( Guo et al., 2025 ) ; our Stage 1 uses R-Zero’s uncertainty reward and repetition penalty, as Agent0 does, but estimates success from the executor’s judged completions rather than from self-consistency.
paragraphs.zh: 自适应任务生成。一旦策略解决了固定任务集，该过程就会停止教学，因此智能体会自行生成任务：WebRL 从失败的尝试中推导出新的网页任务（Qi et al., 2025），SAGE 将课程从简单到复杂逐步扩展（Yang et al., 2025），而 AgentGen 则使合成的任务向更简单或更难的变体演化（Hu et al., 2024）。PAE 使用由 VLM 评估器评分的、来自上下文感知提议者的任务来训练网页智能体（Zhou et al., 2025b）；Self-Challenging 让一个模型编写可验证的任务，然后解决这些任务（Zhou et al., 2025a）；R-Zero 则对挑战者提出一个问题时，若其求解器与自身的答案有一半时间一致，便给予奖励（Huang et al., 2026）。Agent0 交替更新课程和执行器（Xia et al., 2025），而 GenEnv 则训练一个环境策略，以促使智能体达到中等水平的成功（Guo et al., 2025）；我们的第一阶段采用了 R-Zero 的不确定性奖励和重复惩罚机制，与 Agent0 的做法一致，但成功性的评估基于执行器判断为完成的任务，而非自我一致性。

paragraphs.en: Learning inside a web world model. Tasks and injections generated during training need an environment that can execute any of them, such as a world model of page transitions ( Ha and Schmidhuber, 2018 ) ; WMA and WebDreamer use such a model at inference time to choose actions ( Chae et al., 2025 ; Gu et al., 2024 ) . DreamGym trains a policy online on synthesized transitions and rewards with an adaptive task generator ( Chen et al., 2026b ) , WebEvolver trains the policy and the world model together ( Fang et al., 2025 ) , DynaWeb trains web agents with RL on rollouts imagined by a web world model ( Ding et al., 2026 ) , UI-Simulator synthesizes trajectories with an LLM that simulates UI transitions ( Wang et al., 2025a ) , and Qwen-AgentWorld trains language world models as simulators for agentic RL ( Zuo et al., 2026 ) . We freeze WebWorld’s pretrained transition model ( Xiao et al., 2026 ) so that every round and checkpoint is trained and scored against the same simulator; freezing does not make its predictions correct, which is why we also test in a real browser ( Section 5 ).Injection benchmarks, adaptive-attack studies, and LLM-judge validity are discussed in Section D.5 .
paragraphs.zh: 在网页世界模型中进行学习。训练期间生成的任务和注入需要一个能够执行其中任何一项的环境，例如页面转换的世界模型（Ha 和 Schmidhuber，2018）；WMA 和 WebDreamer 在推理阶段使用此类模型来选择动作（Chae 等人，2025；Gu 等人，2024）。DreamGym 通过自适应任务生成器，在合成的状态转换和奖励上在线训练策略（Chen 等人，2026b）；WebEvolver 同时训练策略和世界模型（Fang 等人，2025）；DynaWeb 利用网页世界模型想象出的展开序列，通过强化学习训练网页智能体（Ding 等人，2026）；UI-Simulator 使用能够模拟 UI 转换的大型语言模型来合成轨迹（Wang 等人，2025a）；而 Qwen-AgentWorld 则将语言世界模型训练为智能体强化学习的模拟器（Zuo 等人，2026）。我们冻结了 WebWorld 的预训练状态转换模型（Xiao 等人，2026），以确保每一轮和每个检查点都基于相同的模拟器进行训练和评估；但冻结模型并不会使其预测变得正确，因此我们还在真实浏览器中进行了测试（第 5 节）。注入基准、自适应攻击研究以及 LLM 判定的有效性将在 D.5 节中讨论。

At step t t the executor samples a browser action a t ∼ E ( ⋅ ∣ g , o 0 : t , a 0 : t − 1 ) a_{t}\sim E(\cdot\mid g,o_{0:t},a_{0:t-1}) , such as filling a field, selecting an option, or clicking a control, and the frozen world model W W ( WebWorld-14B ) predicts the next page o t + 1 ∼ W ( ⋅ ∣ h t , a t ) o_{t+1}\sim W(\cdot\mid h_{t},a_{t}) from its interaction history h t h_{t} . A trajectory τ = ( o 0 , a 0 , o 1 , … ) \tau=(o_{0},a_{0},o_{1},\dots) ends when E E sends a final message or after 12 actions. The frozen judge J J ( Qwen3.8-27B ) returns a verdict j ⁡ ( x , τ ) ∈ { 0 , 1 } j(x,\tau)\in\{0,1\} , where 1 1 means that τ \tau is judged to complete g g . For transfer, the same pages are served as HTML in a real Chromium browser, whose live pages replace the predictions of W W .
paragraphs.zh: 环境。一个任务 x = ( g , o 0 ) x=(g,o_{0}) 将授权目标 g g 与初始可访问树页面 o 0 o_{0} 配对。在第 t t 步，执行器会采样一个浏览器操作 a t ∼ E ( ⋅ ∣ g , o 0 : t , a 0 : t − 1 ) a_{t}\sim E(\cdot\mid g,o_{0:t},a_{0:t-1})，例如填写字段、选择选项或点击控件；而冻结的世界模型 W W（WebWorld-14B）则根据交互历史 h t h_{t} 预测下一个页面 o t + 1 ∼ W ( ⋅ ∣ h t , a t ) o_{t+1}\sim W(\cdot\mid h_{t},a_{t})。轨迹 τ = ( o 0 , a 0 , o 1 , … ) \tau=(o_{0},a_{0},o_{1},\dots) 在 E E 发送最终消息或执行完 12 个操作后结束。冻结的评判器 J J（Qwen3.8-27B）会返回一个判决 j ⁡ ( x , τ ) ∈ { 0 , 1 } j(x,\tau)\in\{0,1\}，其中 1 1 表示轨迹 τ \tau 被判定为完成了目标 g g。在迁移过程中，相同的页面将以 HTML 格式通过真实的 Chromium 浏览器呈现，其实时页面将取代 W W 的预测结果。

paragraphs.en: Benchmark. We evaluate on a fixed set 𝒳 \mathcal{X} of 150 form-filling tasks from ten templates in five skill strata: conditional policy, derived values, conjunctive selection, relational join, and ordered repair ( Appendix A ). Every page holds the records and rules that determine the answer, and every task specifies the required final field values and final control, two protected fields that must stay unchanged, and two forbidden controls, Save draft and Reset all, that must never be activated. In the browser, a deterministic check s ⁡ ( x , τ ) ∈ { 0 , 1 } s(x,\tau)\in\{0,1\} equals 1 1 only if the submitted values match these requirements, the protected fields are unchanged, no forbidden control was activated, and a review preceded the commit where the task requires one. The evaluation tasks are distinct from the tasks the curriculum proposes during training.
paragraphs.zh: 基准测试。我们在一个固定的集合 𝒳 \mathcal{X} 上进行评估，该集合包含来自五个技能层级中十个模板的 150 个表单填写任务：条件策略、派生值、联合选择、关系连接和有序修复（附录 A）。每一页都包含决定答案的记录和规则，每个任务都会指定所需的最终字段值和最终控制操作、两个必须保持不变的受保护字段，以及两个绝不可激活的禁止控制操作——“保存草稿”和“全部重置”。在浏览器中，一个确定性检查 s⁡(x,τ)∈{0,1} 仅在提交的值符合这些要求、受保护字段未发生更改、没有激活任何禁止控制操作，并且在需要审核的任务中已完成审核时才会等于 1。评估任务与课程在训练期间提出的任务有所不同。

paragraphs.en: Threat model. The provider seeks task-preserving robustness, which requires its web executor E E to complete the authorized goal despite competing page instructions whenever the task remains feasible. The provider controls the executor’s system instructions and training, while keeping the world model W W and judge J J fixed. The attacker is a page author who aims to prevent authorized completion; inducing a particular target action is optional. It acts through one injection per trajectory: after an executor action a d a_{d} it supplies an instruction z z , and W W predicts the next page with the requested notice, o d + 1 ∼ W ( ⋅ ∣ h d , a d , z ) o_{d+1}\sim W(\cdot\mid h_{d},a_{d},z) , from which E E continues; the initial page remains clean. It cannot modify the authorized goal, executor system instructions or parameters, or judge rubric. During evaluation, it observes the current page and the selected action at each step and chooses whether to wait or inject. Evaluation permits at most eleven calls to the frozen attacker, each capped at 256 output tokens, and stops querying it after an injection request. We evaluate two kinds of attacker under this interface: the learned adversaries Adv v1–v3 saved during Stage 2, whose attacks also trained the executor, and Kimi-K3 , a frontier model that took no part in training. Injections pass through W W , which is trained on real web transitions and renders a request only as a plausible page: an author-placeable notice appears in the style of the current page, while an implausible request (e.g., removing the site) is softened or dropped ( Table 6 b). This limits attacks to content a real page author could produce, but can also omit requested content or remove controls the task needs; all attacked results are therefore verdicts of J J inside W W , and Kimi-K3 tests generalization beyond the training loop. The judge reads the same untrusted observations as the executor.
paragraphs.zh: 威胁模型。提供商追求任务保留的鲁棒性，这要求其网络执行器 E E 在任务仍然可行的情况下，即便页面存在相互冲突的指令，也能完成授权目标。提供商控制执行器的系统指令和训练过程，同时保持世界模型 W W 和评判者 J J 固定不变。攻击者是一名页面作者，其目标是阻止授权任务的完成；诱导特定的目标动作并非必需。它通过每条轨迹中的一次注入来实施攻击：在执行器执行动作 a d a_{d} 之后，它会提供一个指令 z z ，此时 W W 会根据该请求生成下一个页面的预测结果 o d + 1 ∼ W ( ⋅ ∣ h d , a d , z ) o_{d+1}\sim W(\cdot\mid h_{d},a_{d},z) ，执行器 E E 则据此继续操作；初始页面保持干净。攻击者无法修改授权目标、执行器的系统指令或参数，也无法更改评判标准。在评估过程中，它在每一步都会观察当前页面和已选动作，并决定是等待还是进行注入。评估允许最多对冻结的攻击者发起十一次调用，每次调用最多输出 256 个标记，并且在发出注入请求后停止向其查询。我们在此接口下评估了两种攻击者：在阶段 2 中保存的已学习对抗模型 Adv v1–v3（其攻击也用于训练执行器），以及 Kimi-K3——一个未参与训练的顶尖模型。注入内容需经过 W W 处理；W W 是在真实网络页面跳转数据上训练的，因此它只会将请求渲染为看似合理的页面：可被作者插入的内容会以当前页面的风格呈现，而不合理的要求（例如删除整个网站）则会被弱化或忽略（表 6b）。这将攻击限制在真实页面作者可能生成的内容范围内，但也可能导致请求的内容未被包含，或任务所需的控制机制被移除；因此，所有受攻击的结果都是 W W 内部 J J 的评判结果，而 Kimi-K3 则用于测试模型在训练循环之外的泛化能力。评判者与执行器读取相同的不可信观察信息。

Clean and attacked completion are the percentages of these tasks judged complete,

paragraphs.en: and the learned-adversary score averages C r A \mathrm{C}^{A}_{r} over Adv v1–v3 with equal weight. We report the mean and sample standard deviation over seeds: three evaluation runs of one trained checkpoint (two for Kimi-K3 ), not three training runs (per-seed counts in Section C.1 ). Strict browser success replaces j j with s s on browser trajectories. We measure task completion only and do not measure attacker-objective success, which AgentDojo and WASP report separately ( Debenedetti et al., 2024 ; Evtimov et al., 2025 ) , and we do not verify that a task remains feasible after an injection.
paragraphs.zh: 并且，学习到的对抗方得分 C r A \mathrm{C}^{A}_{r} 在 Adv v1–v3 上以相等权重取平均值。我们报告了在不同种子下的均值和样本标准差：针对每个训练检查点执行三次评估运行（Kimi-K3 为两次），而非三次训练运行（每颗种子的具体次数见第 C.1 节）。在浏览器轨迹中，严格的浏览器成功判定将 j j 替换为 s s。我们仅衡量任务完成度，而不衡量攻击者目标的达成情况——AgentDojo 和 WASP 对此进行了单独报告（Debenedetti et al., 2024；Evtimov et al., 2025），并且我们并未验证注入操作后任务是否仍然可行。

paragraphs.en: AdvSim2Real trains three policies inside the frozen world model W W : a curriculum C C that proposes tasks, an executor E E that completes them, and an adversary A A that requests injected page content through W W . A frozen judge J J grades every run, and both rewards are defined relative to the current executor ( Figure 3 ).
paragraphs.zh: AdvSim2Real 在冻结的世界模型 W W 内部训练三种策略：一个提出任务的课程 C C、一个完成这些任务的执行器 E E，以及一个通过 W W 请求注入页面内容的对抗者 A A。一个冻结的评判者 J J 会对每次运行进行评分，并且两种奖励都是相对于当前的执行器来定义的（图 3）。

paragraphs.en: Algorithm 1 lists the steps. In Stage 1 (lines 2 – 7 ), C C proposes a pool of tasks and E E attempts each task several times; C C is rewarded for tasks that E E solves about half of the time, and E E then trains on fresh tasks from the updated C C . In Stage 2 (lines 8 – 18 ), C C is frozen, E E continues from its last Stage-1 checkpoint, and A A starts from the base model. On tasks that E E solves at least half of the time, we save several clean runs. A A proposes one injection and the step at which to insert it; each saved run is replayed up to that step with the injection, and A A is rewarded only when the injection is rendered and a run that J J accepted without it now fails. E E then trains on a mixture of the new attacks, the attacks of earlier rounds, and clean tasks. The executor after round t t is Capability iter t t in Stage 1 and Robust iter t t in Stage 2; each stage runs three rounds.
paragraphs.zh: 算法 1 列出了具体步骤。在阶段 1（第 2 – 7 行）中，C C 提出一组任务，E E 对每个任务进行多次尝试；对于 E E 大约有一半时间能解决的任务，C C 会获得奖励，随后 E E 会在更新后的 C C 提供的全新任务上进行训练。在阶段 2（第 8 – 18 行）中，C C 被冻结，E E 从其阶段 1 的最后一个检查点继续执行，而 A A 则从基础模型开始。对于 E E 至少有一半时间能解决的任务，我们会保存几次干净的运行记录。A A 会提出一次注入操作以及插入该操作的步骤；每次保存的运行都会连同该注入操作一起重播至对应步骤，并且只有当注入操作被应用后，原本 J J 在没有注入的情况下能够接受的运行现在却失败时，A A 才会获得奖励。随后，E E 会在新的攻击、早期轮次的攻击以及干净任务的混合数据集上进行训练。第 t t 轮执行后的能力模型为阶段 1 中的 Capability iter t t 和阶段 2 中的 Robust iter t t；每个阶段运行三轮。

paragraphs.en: Stage 1: Curriculum-executor co-evolution. Rollouts of E E in W W and their verdicts j ⁡ ( x , τ ) j(x,\tau) follow Section 3 . A rollout group in which every trajectory receives the same reward has zero group-relative advantage ( Equation 4 ), so a task the executor always solves or always fails contributes nothing to its update.
paragraphs.zh: 阶段 1：课程-执行器协同进化。在 W W 中执行 E E 的多次运行及其判决 j ⁡ ( x , τ ) j(x,\tau) 遵循第 3 节的描述。在一个所有轨迹都获得相同奖励的运行组中，组内相对优势为零（方程 4），因此，执行器总能解决或始终失败的任务，对其更新没有任何贡献。

paragraphs.en: Curriculum reward. To assess a proposal x x , we run K K trajectories τ 1 , … , τ K \tau_{1},\ldots,\tau_{K} under the current executor and estimate its success rate from their verdicts j k = j ⁡ ( x , τ k ) j_{k}=j(x,\tau_{k}) ( Section D.1 ),
paragraphs.zh: 课程奖励。为了评估提案 x x，我们在当前执行器下运行 K K 条轨迹 τ 1 , … , τ K \tau_{1},\ldots,\tau_{K}，并根据这些轨迹的判断结果 j k = j ⁡ ( x , τ k ) j_{k}=j(x,\tau_{k})（见 D.1 节）来估计其成功率。

A validity gate ν ⁡ ( x ) ∈ { 0 , 1 } \nu(x)\in\{0,1\} removes unparseable or never-solved proposals ( Section D.1 ). Zero observed successes do not establish impossibility, and a task solved in every assessment also earns zero; difficulty pressure comes from the loop, not from a fixed target. Let 𝒫 \mathcal{P} denote the valid proposals in one curriculum update, n ⁡ ( x ) n(x) the number of them in the same lexical-similarity cluster as x x , counting x x itself ( Section D.2 ), and λ C \lambda_{C} the weight of a repetition penalty as in R-Zero:

paragraphs.en: Scaling after normalization preserves within-group contrast while upweighting tasks near the competence frontier; the floor keeps a nonzero gradient elsewhere ( Figure 7 ).
paragraphs.zh: 归一化后的缩放保留了组内对比，同时提升了接近能力边界的任务的权重；而底线则在其他区域保持非零梯度（图 7）。

paragraphs.en: Stage 2: Adversary-executor co-evolution. An adversary rewarded for every executor failure would be credited for failures that also occur without an injection, so A A is rewarded only for success flips against the current executor.
paragraphs.zh: 阶段 2：对抗者与执行者的协同进化。对于每次执行者失败而获得奖励的对抗者，其奖励也会涵盖那些无需注入即可发生的失败，因此 A A 仅因针对当前执行者的成功翻转而获得奖励。

paragraphs.en: Clean controls. Each round, the frozen curriculum proposes a pool D D ; for the tasks D A = { x ∈ D : p ^ J ​ ( x ) ≥ η } D_{A}=\{x\in D:\widehat{p}_{J}(x)\geq\eta\} whose p ^ J ​ ( x ) \widehat{p}_{J}(x) reaches the screening threshold η \eta ( Section D.3 ), we collect K K clean trajectories with saved histories, which we call controls , and let c i ∈ { 0 , 1 } c_{i}\in\{0,1\} mark a good verdict on control i i . Tasks with ∑ i c i = 0 \sum_{i}c_{i}=0 are dropped.
paragraphs.zh: 干净的对照样本。每一轮中，冻结课程会提出一个池 D D；对于满足 p ^ J ​ ( x ) \widehat{p}_{J}(x) 达到筛选阈值 η \eta（见第 D.3 节）的任务 D A = { x ∈ D : p ^ J ​ ( x ) ≥ η } D_{A}=\{x\in D:\widehat{p}_{J}(x)\geq\eta\}，我们会收集 K K 条带有保存历史记录的干净轨迹，并将其称为“对照样本”，同时用 c i ∈ { 0 , 1 } c_{i}\in\{0,1\} 来标记对照样本 i i 的判断是否良好。满足 ∑ i c i = 0 \sum_{i}c_{i}=0 的任务将被舍弃。

paragraphs.en: Adversary reward. From the goal and initial page, A A samples a proposal α = ( z , m , d , ζ ) \alpha=(z,m,d,\zeta) : an injection instruction z z , a marker m m whose presence in the predicted page confirms rendering, the transition index d d at which to inject, and an optional target action ζ \zeta . For each control, we resume its saved history at transition d d , pass z z to W W with the pending executor action, and let the fixed executor continue; the continuation shares the control’s prefix, pending action, and seed, but not the backend’s random state. Let b i α , v i α ∈ { 0 , 1 } b_{i}^{\alpha},v_{i}^{\alpha}\in\{0,1\} mark a bad verdict on the attacked continuation and a passed rendering check for m m . With 𝒫 x \mathcal{P}_{x} the valid proposals for x x in one comparison group, n A ​ ( z ) n_{A}(z) the number of them in the same lexical-similarity cluster as z z , and λ A \lambda_{A} the penalty weight,
paragraphs.zh: 对抗方奖励。从目标和初始页面出发，A A 采样一个提案 α = ( z , m , d , ζ ) \alpha=(z,m,d,\zeta)：一个注入指令 z z、一个标记 m m（其在预测页面中的存在确认了渲染）、用于注入的转换索引 d d，以及一个可选的目标动作 ζ \zeta。对于每个控制单元，我们从转换 d d 处恢复其保存的历史记录，将 z z 连同待处理的执行器动作传入 W W，并让固定的执行器继续运行；该延续过程共享控制单元的前缀、待处理动作和种子，但不共享后端的随机状态。令 b i α , v i α ∈ { 0 , 1 } b_{i}^{\alpha},v_{i}^{\alpha}\in\{0,1\} 分别标记对受攻击延续的无效判定以及对 m m 的渲染检查通过。其中，𝒫 x \mathcal{P}_{x} 表示 x x 在一个比较组中的有效提案，n A ​ ( z ) n_{A}(z) 表示与 z z 处于同一词汇相似性簇中的提案数量，λ A \lambda_{A} 为惩罚权重。

paragraphs.en: A malformed proposal receives − 1 -1 ( Section D.4 ). The reward measures judged disruption and verifies neither that the task remained feasible nor that ζ \zeta was taken.
paragraphs.zh: 格式错误的提案将得到 −1 -1（D.4 节）。该奖励衡量了判断到的干扰，但既未验证任务是否仍然可行，也未验证 ζ \zeta 是否已被采用。

paragraphs.en: Executor update under attack. The mixture D E D_{E} keeps only task inputs; stored trajectories and verdicts are discarded. We assess the mixture D E D_{E} with the current executor and train E E on G G fresh trajectories per task, with reward R E R_{E} of + 1 +1 for a good verdict, − 1 -1 for a bad verdict, and 0 0 for a bad verdict that avoids a declared target ζ \zeta ( Section D.4 ). Advantages follow Equation 4 with the mixture assessment ( Algorithm 2 ).
paragraphs.zh: 执行器在攻击下更新。混合分布 D E D_{E} 仅保留任务输入；存储的轨迹和判决被丢弃。我们使用当前的执行器对混合分布 D E D_{E} 进行评估，并为每个任务在 G G 条新轨迹上训练 E E。对于良好的判决，奖励 R E R_{E} 为 +1；对于不良的判决，奖励为 −1；而对于虽为不良判决但避开了已声明的目标 ζ \zeta 的情况（见第 D.4 节），奖励为 0。优势遵循混合分布评估下的方程 4（算法 2）。

paragraphs.en: Policy optimization. Each role trains a separate low-rank adapter with group-normalized advantages and a penalty toward the adapter-disabled base model, without likelihood ratios, clipping, or importance correction for curriculum replay ( Section D.2 ).
paragraphs.zh: 策略优化。每个角色都训练一个独立的低秩适配器，使用经过组归一化的优势值以及对禁用适配器的基础模型施加惩罚，且不对课程重播进行似然比、截断或重要性校正（D.2 节）。

paragraphs.en: Setup. We evaluate on the 150 tasks of Section 3 with three rollout seeds per checkpoint. Checkpoints are named after the round of Algorithm 1 that produced them, and each stage runs three rounds. Capability iter t t is the executor E E after t t Stage-1 rounds, and Robust iter t t is the executor after t t Stage-2 rounds started from Capability iter 3. Adv v t t is the adversary A A saved after Stage-2 round t t . We evaluate the Qwen3.5-4B base model, Capability iter 1–3, Robust iter 1–3, and hosted Qwen3.5-9B as a reference.
paragraphs.zh: 设置。我们在第 3 节的 150 个任务上进行评估，每个检查点使用三个展开种子。检查点的命名依据是生成它们的算法 1 的轮次，每个阶段运行三轮。Capability iter t t 是执行 t t 轮 Stage-1 后的执行器 E E，而 Robust iter t t 是从 Capability iter 3 开始执行 t t 轮 Stage-2 后的执行器。Adv v t t 是在 Stage-2 第 t t 轮后保存的对手 A A。我们评估了 Qwen3.5-4B 基础模型、Capability iter 1–3、Robust iter 1–3，以及作为参考的托管版 Qwen3.5-9B。

paragraphs.en: Stage 1 raises clean completion by 4.44 points. Clean completion rises from 74.89 % 74.89\% (Base) to 78.00 % 78.00\% , 77.11 % 77.11\% , and 79.33 % 79.33\% over the three Stage-1 rounds ( Table 1 ). The gain is not uniform: each Stage-1 update improves 23 to 28 tasks and regresses 19 to 21, judged by the number of good seeds per task ( Section B.1 ). Without ever seeing an injection, Stage 1 also lifts the attack mean from 48.07 % 48.07\% to 54.74 % 54.74\% after the first round, after which it stays between 54.34 % 54.34\% and 55.41 % 55.41\% .
paragraphs.zh: 第一阶段使干净完成率提升了 4.44 个百分点。干净完成率从 74.89 % 74.89\%（基准）提升至 78.00 % 78.00\%、77.11 % 77.11\% 和 79.33 % 79.33\%，分别对应第一阶段的三轮迭代（表 1）。这一提升并非均匀分布：根据每轮任务中优质种子的数量判断，每次第一阶段更新都会使 23 至 28 项任务得到改善，而 19 至 21 项任务则出现退化（B.1 节）。此外，在第一阶段从未接触注入样本的情况下，攻击均值也从 48.07 % 48.07\% 提升至 54.74 % 54.74\%，并在后续迭代中稳定在 54.34 % 54.34\% 至 55.41 % 55.41\% 之间。

paragraphs.en: Sim-to-real transfer. The capability checkpoints were also run on the same 150 tasks in a real Chromium browser, with the frozen initial page rendered as HTML, live DOM observations, and no world-model call ( Table 2 ). Strict browser success, a deterministic check of the submitted form rather than a model verdict, rises from 25.56 % 25.56\% for Base to 31.78 % 31.78\% , 43.56 % 43.56\% , and 44.44 % 44.44\% over the three Stage-1 rounds, and correct final field values from 52.50 % 52.50\% to 73.24 % 73.24\% .
paragraphs.zh: 从模拟到现实的迁移。能力检查点也在相同的 150 项任务中，于真实的 Chromium 浏览器上运行，其中冻结的初始页面以 HTML 形式渲染，并进行了实时 DOM 观察，但未调用世界模型（表 2）。严格的浏览器成功率——即通过提交表单进行确定性验证，而非依赖模型判断——在三个阶段 1 的轮次中，从 Base 的 25.56 % 25.56\% 提升至 31.78 % 31.78\%、43.56 % 43.56\% 和 44.44 % 44.44\%；最终字段值的正确率则从 52.50 % 52.50\% 提升至 73.24 % 73.24\%。

paragraphs.en: The ordering of the four checkpoints is the same under the deterministic check, the field count, and the trajectory judge ( Section C.3 ), so the Stage-1 gain measured in the world model is a gain in executed task completion. Per task and seed, the share solved in both the world model and the browser rises from 23.1 % 23.1\% for Base to 42.9 % 42.9\% for Capability iter 3, and the share judged good only in the world model falls from 51.8 % 51.8\% to 36.4 % 36.4\% ( Figure 4 c). Absolute rates are lower than in the world model because the browser rejects malformed actions that the world model tolerated ; Base issues at least one invalid action in 132 of 450 episodes and Capability iter 3 in 67 ( Section C.3 ). Stage 2 optimizes robustness inside W W , where injections are rendered ( Section 3 ), and is not evaluated in the browser.
paragraphs.zh: 在确定性检查、字段计数和轨迹判断（C.3 节）中，四个检查点的顺序保持一致，因此在世界模型中测得的阶段 1 增益，即实际任务完成率的提升。对于每个任务和种子，世界模型与浏览器中成功解决的比例均从 Base 的 23.1%（23.1\%）上升至 Capability iter 3 的 42.9%（42.9\%），而仅在世界模型中被判断为成功的比例则从 51.8%（51.8\%）下降至 36.4%（36.4\%）（图 4c）。绝对比率低于世界模型中的数值，因为浏览器会拒绝世界模型所容忍的格式错误操作；在 450 次试验中，Base 至少有 132 次执行了无效操作，而 Capability iter 3 则有 67 次（C.3 节）。阶段 2 优化的是 W W 内部的鲁棒性，其中注入操作在此处生成（第 3 节），且不在浏览器中进行评估。

paragraphs.en: Stage 2 raises attacked completion by 3.14 points without a clean trade-off. From Capability iter 3, the attack mean moves to 53.70 % 53.70\% , 56.44 % 56.44\% , and 57.48 % 57.48\% and clean completion to 77.33 % 77.33\% , 78.00 % 78.00\% , and 81.33 % 81.33\% over the three Stage-2 rounds. The first round lowers both metrics, by 0.64 0.64 points under attack and 2.00 2.00 points clean; the second and third rounds recover and exceed the starting point. Robust iter 3 ends 3.14 3.14 points higher under attack than Capability iter 3 and 2.00 2.00 points higher clean. The attacked gain is concentrated on the first adversary: 5.78 5.78 points against Adv v1, 2.54 2.54 against Adv v2, and 1.11 1.11 against Adv v3. By skill stratum, Robust iter 3 gains most over Base on conditional-policy ( + 14.3 +14.3 points) and conjunctive-selection tasks ( + 12.8 +12.8 ) and least on relational joins ( + 1.6 +1.6 ); conjunctive selection stays the hardest stratum at 40.6 % 40.6\% ( Figure 4 d). Figure 2 shows one injection that diverts Base and fails against Robust iter 3. A 23.85 23.85 -point clean-to-attacked gap remains at the final checkpoint.
paragraphs.zh: 第 2 阶段在没有干净权衡的情况下，使受攻击的完成率提升了 3.14 分。从能力迭代 3 开始，攻击均值分别变为 53.70 % 53.70\%、56.44 % 56.44\% 和 57.48 % 57.48\%，而干净完成率则分别为 77.33 % 77.33\%、78.00 % 78.00\% 和 81.33 % 81.33\%（涵盖第 2 阶段的三轮）。第一轮使两项指标均下降：攻击情况下下降 0.64 分，干净情况下下降 2.00 分；第二轮和第三轮则恢复并超过了初始值。稳健迭代 3 在攻击情况下的得分比能力迭代 3 高出 3.14 分，干净情况下的得分则高出 2.00 分。受攻击时的增益主要集中在第一个对抗者上：针对 Adv v1 的增益为 5.78 分，针对 Adv v2 的增益为 2.54 分，针对 Adv v3 的增益为 1.11 分。按技能层级来看，稳健迭代 3 在基于条件策略的任务中（+14.3 分）以及在合取选择任务中（+12.8 分）相比基础模型获得的增益最大，而在关系连接任务中的增益最小（+1.6 分）；合取选择仍然是最难处理的层级，完成率为 40.6 % 40.6\%（图 4d）。图 2 展示了一种注入攻击，它偏离了基础模型但在稳健迭代 3 面前未能成功。在最终检查点时，干净情况与受攻击情况之间的差距仍为 23.85 分。

paragraphs.en: The final 4B checkpoint matches the hosted 9B under attack and beats it clean. Qwen3.5-9B runs with the same prompt, action interface, and 12-action budget, but as a hosted model whose served weights and raw trajectories we do not hold. On matched task and seed identities, Robust iter 3 reaches 57.40 % 57.40\% under attack against 56.96 % 56.96\% , and 81.33 % 81.33\% clean against 78.22 % 78.22\% , a 3.11 3.11 -point clean advantage for the 4B checkpoint. The 0.44 0.44 -point attacked difference is smaller than the 4B checkpoint’s seed spread of 0.56 0.56 points and varies by adversary: Robust iter 3 is higher against Adv v1 and lower against Adv v2 and v3.
paragraphs.zh: 最终的 4B 检查点在攻击测试中与托管的 9B 模型表现一致，并在干净测试中完全胜出。Qwen3.5-9B 使用相同的提示、动作接口和 12 次动作预算运行，但它是一个托管模型，其服务权重和原始轨迹我们并不持有。在任务和种子身份匹配的情况下，Robust iter 3 在攻击测试中的准确率为 57.40 % 57.40\%，而对手模型为 56.96 % 56.96\%；在干净测试中，其准确率为 81.33 % 81.33\%，而对手模型为 78.22 % 78.22\%。这意味着 4B 检查点在干净测试中拥有 3.11 个点的优势。攻击测试中的 0.44 点差异小于 4B 检查点的种子分布差异（0.56 点），且该差异因对手而异：Robust iter 3 在对抗 Adv v1 时表现更高，而在对抗 Adv v2 和 v3 时表现更低。

paragraphs.en: A frontier-model adversary lowers Base to 23.00% and training adds 7.72 points. Adv v1–v3 were trained during Stage 2 against the Robust lineage, so we also evaluate Base and every Stage-2 checkpoint against an external adversary that took no part in training. Kimi-K3, a hosted frontier model, replaces the learned adversary under the interface and budget of Section 3 ; the checkpoints, world model, judge, tasks, and decoding settings are unchanged ( Section C.4 ). Base falls from 74.89 % 74.89\% clean to 23.00 % 23.00\% , which is 25.07 25.07 points below its 48.07 % 48.07\% against the learned adversaries ( Table 3 ). Robust iter 1, 2, and 3 reach 29.67 % 29.67\% , 30.33 % 30.33\% , and 30.72 % 30.72\% , which is 6.67 6.67 , 7.33 7.33 , and 7.72 7.72 points above Base. The three Stage-2 rounds lie within 1.05 1.05 points of one another, so the gain arrives with the first round. Kimi-K3 requests an injection in 95.0 % 95.0\% to 98.0 % 98.0\% of episodes, against 66.5 % 66.5\% to 81.0 % 81.0\% for the learned adversaries, and the world model renders the requested injection in 72.3 % 72.3\% to 80.9 % 80.9\% of episodes ( Figure 4 b). Under Kimi-K3, Base exhausts the 12-action budget without a final message in 28.3 % 28.3\% of episodes, against 14.0 % 14.0\% to 15.4 % 15.4\% for the Robust checkpoints and 3.7 % 3.7\% of clean episodes pooled over all checkpoints. The robustness gained in training therefore holds against an adversary outside the training loop. However, every checkpoint still loses at least 47.66 47.66 points of clean completion to a frontier-model adversary limited to one injection per trajectory.
paragraphs.zh: 前沿模型对抗智能体将 Base 的得分降至 23.00%，而训练则增加了 7.72 分。Adv v1–v3 是在第 2 阶段针对 Robust 谱系进行训练的，因此我们还使用一个未参与训练的独立对抗智能体来评估 Base 以及所有第 2 阶段的检查点。Kimi-K3 是一款托管的前沿模型，它在第 3 节所述的接口和预算框架下替代了学习得到的对抗智能体；检查点、世界模型、评判者、任务和解码设置均保持不变（见第 C.4 节）。Base 的得分从 74.89% 74.89\%（干净完成）降至 23.00% 23.00\%，比其在对抗学习智能体时的得分 48.07% 48.07\% 低了 25.07 分（见第 3 表）。Robust 的第 1、2 和 3 次迭代分别达到 29.67% 29.67\%、30.33% 30.33\% 和 30.72% 30.72\%，比 Base 分别高出 6.67、7.33 和 7.72 分。第 2 阶段的三轮结果彼此差异不超过 1.05 分，因此性能提升已出现在第一轮。在 Kimi-K3 下，请求注入的比例为 95.0% 95.0\% 至 98.0% 98.0\%（针对所有回合），而学习得到的对抗智能体对应的比例则为 66.5% 66.5\% 至 81.0% 81.0\%；世界模型在 72.3% 72.3\% 至 80.9% 80.9\% 的回合中执行了所请求的注入（见第 4b 图）。在使用 Kimi-K3 时，Base 在 28.3% 28.3\% 的回合中用完了 12 次行动的预算却未发出最终消息，而 Robust 检查点的这一比例在 14.0% 14.0\% 至 15.4% 15.4\% 之间，所有检查点合并后的干净完成回合比例为 3.7% 3.7\%。因此，训练中获得鲁棒性在面对训练循环之外的对抗智能体时依然有效。然而，每个检查点在对抗一个每条轨迹仅允许一次注入的前沿模型时，仍会损失至少 47.66 分的干净完成得分。

paragraphs.en: Removing Stage 1 costs 4.67 clean points but only 0.44 under attack. The ablation starts Stage 2 from the base model for both executor and curriculum, with the same rounds and epochs, and faces the same Adv v1–v3 ( Section C.5 ). We call its executor after round t t Ablation iter t t . Its clean completion reaches 71.56 % 71.56\% , 76.00 % 76.00\% , and 76.67 % 76.67\% and its attack mean 52.81 % 52.81\% , 56.96 % 56.96\% , and 57.04 % 57.04\% ( Figure 4 a; Table 7 ). The clean difference favors the complete pipeline at every round, by 5.78 5.78 , 2.00 2.00 , and 4.67 4.67 points. The attacked difference does not: the complete pipeline leads by 0.89 0.89 points after round one, trails by 0.52 0.52 after round two, and leads by 0.44 0.44 after round three. The ablation removes executor and curriculum initialization jointly and does not match compute, so it measures the two pipelines, not the curriculum alone.
paragraphs.zh: 移除阶段 1 会消耗 4.67 个干净积分，但在攻击下仅消耗 0.44 个。消融分析对执行器和课程模型均从基础模型开始阶段 2，使用相同的轮数和 эпохи，并面对相同的 Adv v1–v3（见第 C.5 节）。我们将其在第 t 轮后的执行器称为 Ablation iter t t。其干净完成度分别达到 71.56%、76.00% 和 76.67%，而攻击下的平均值分别为 52.81%、56.96% 和 57.04%（图 4a；表 7）。在干净表现方面，完整流程在每一轮都更具优势，领先幅度为 5.78、2.00 和 4.67 积分。但在攻击下情况则不同：完整流程在第一轮后领先 0.89 积分，第二轮后落后 0.52 积分，第三轮后则领先 0.44 积分。该消融分析同时移除了执行器和课程的初始化部分，且计算量不匹配，因此它衡量的是两种流程之间的差异，而非仅课程模型本身。

paragraphs.en: Effectiveness and analysis. The endpoint gains of AdvSim2Real are 6.44 6.44 clean points and 9.41 9.41 attacked points on the same 150 tasks, but the first adversarial round lowers both metrics before later rounds recover them; because the evaluation isolates no single component, we attribute the gains to the checkpoint sequence as a whole. We designed for three mechanisms, none of which we have isolated: (i) the curriculum reward is zero at judged rates 0 0 and 1 1 , so proposals the executor never or always solves stop earning reward; (ii) the reward for a success flip is zero for failures the executor produces on its own, so the adversary cannot profit from tasks the executor would fail anyway; and (iii) historical attack inputs stay in the executor’s mixture with fresh labels, so an injection that stops working is not forgotten.
paragraphs.zh: 有效性与分析。在相同的 150 项任务中，AdvSim2Real 的终点增益为 6.44 个干净分数和 9.41 个受攻击分数，但第一轮对抗性攻击会先降低这两项指标，随后几轮才会恢复；由于评估并未单独隔离任何单一组件，我们将这些增益归因于整个检查点序列。我们设计了三种机制，但目前尚未对其中任何一种进行单独验证：(i) 在判断率分别为 0 和 1 时，课程奖励为零，因此执行器从未解决或总能解决的问题将不再获得奖励；(ii) 对于执行器自行导致的失败，成功翻转的奖励为零，因此对抗者无法从执行器本就会失败的任务中获利；以及 (iii) 历史攻击输入会连同新的标签保留在执行器的混合模型中，因此即使某种注入手段停止生效，也不会被遗忘。

paragraphs.en: Removing Stage 1, cost, and outlook. Starting Stage 2 from the base model lowers the final clean rate by 4.67 4.67 points but the attack mean by only 0.44 0.44 points, with attack differences of both signs across adversaries ( Table 7 ), so the ablation does not establish a robustness benefit from Stage 1. One recorded Stage-1 iteration reserved two 96 GB RTX 6000 Pro GPUs for 20 h 46 min, or 41.54 41.54 allocated GPU-hours ( Section C.6 ); token counts and API charges for the complete sequence were not measured, so we report no end-to-end price. A training procedure that hardens a web agent against injections should be evaluated against adversaries that did not shape its training, as Kimi-K3 does here, and ultimately against one that adapts to the trained agent; blinded human audits, executable task checkers, and compute-matched component controls are the measurements this requires next.
paragraphs.zh: 移除阶段 1、成本和前景预测。从基础模型开始阶段 2，会使最终清洁率降低 4.67 个点数，但攻击均值仅降低 0.44 个点数，且不同对抗样本的攻击差异正负皆有（表 7），因此该消融实验未能证明阶段 1 能带来稳健性提升。记录在案的一次阶段 1 迭代使用了两台 96 GB 的 RTX 6000 Pro GPU，持续时间为 20 小时 46 分钟，即 41.54 个分配 GPU-小时（C.6 节）；完整序列的令牌数量及 API 费用并未测量，因此我们未报告端到端的成本。用于增强网络智能体以抵御注入攻击的训练流程，应当针对那些未参与其训练过程的对抗样本进行评估（如 Kimi-K3 在此处所做），并最终评估其对抗能够适应已训练智能体的样本；接下来需要采用的评估方法包括盲测式人工审计、可执行的任务检查器以及计算资源匹配的分组件控制。

paragraphs.en: Limitations. The world model can display a value the executor never entered and the judge can accept a wrong calculation, so a judged robustness gain is not yet a gain in executable task completion; only the capability checkpoints were verified in a browser ( Table 2 ). The training adversary proposes from the initial page while the evaluation adversary reacts to the trajectory, and a reactive adversary generates different injections for different executors, so matching an adversary checkpoint matches the attacker, not the attack (further limitations in Section C.8 ).
paragraphs.zh: 局限性。世界模型可能会显示执行者从未输入过的值，而评判者也可能接受错误的计算结果，因此，经过评判的鲁棒性提升，并不一定意味着任务执行能力的提升；只有能力检查点在浏览器中得到了验证（表 2）。训练对抗智能体从初始页面发起提议，而评估对抗智能体则对执行轨迹做出反应，并且反应型对抗智能体会为不同的执行者生成不同的注入内容，因此，匹配一个对抗智能体检查点所对应的是攻击者本身，而非具体的攻击行为（更多局限性见 C.8 节）。

paragraphs.en: We propose AdvSim2Real , which co-evolves a task curriculum, an injection adversary, and an executor inside a frozen web world model. On 150 web tasks, clean completion rises from 74.89 % 74.89\% to 81.33 % 81.33\% and completion under three learned adversaries from 48.07 % 48.07\% to 57.48 % 57.48\% , matching a hosted 9B model, and completion under the unseen Kimi-K3 rises by 33.6 % 33.6\% relative to the base agent. A 23.85 23.85 -point clean-to-attacked gap remains, and every robustness number is a model judgment inside one web world model. We release our code, the benchmark, and all checkpoint results so that injection defenses can be evaluated against adversaries trained on the defended agent.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 AdvSim2Real，该方法在冻结的网页世界模型内部协同演化任务课程、注入对抗者和执行器。在 150 个网页任务中，干净完成率从 74.89 % 74.89\% 提升至 81.33 % 81.33\%，而在三个已学习对抗者下的完成率则从 48.07 % 48.07\% 提升至 57.48 % 57.48\%，与一个托管的 9B 模型相当；在未见过的 Kimi-K3 对抗者下的完成率相较于基础智能体提升了 33.6 % 33.6\%。干净状态与受攻击状态之间仍存在 23.85 23.85 分的差距，且所有鲁棒性数值均是在单一网页世界模型内部由模型判断得出的。我们公开了代码、基准测试以及所有检查点结果，以便能够针对基于受保护智能体训练的对抗者，对注入防御机制进行评估。

paragraphs.en: Language models are components of the method: the curriculum, adversary, and executor policies, the WebWorld-14B world model, the Qwen3.8-27B judge, and the Kimi-K3 evaluation adversary. Separately from these components, we used generative AI assistants to assist with experimental design, qualitative trajectory audits, and result interpretation, to support literature search and reference formatting, to draft text, equations, and diagrams, and to check the manuscript for internal inconsistencies. We did not use generative AI to refine research hypotheses, and mathematical proofs and translation are not applicable to this work. Every reported number was computed from saved experimental records, no missing measurement was filled with generated values, and the aggregate rates in Tables 1, 2, 3, and 7 can be recomputed from the per-seed counts in Table 5. The authors reviewed all AI-assisted content and take full responsibility for the text, claims, and artifacts in this paper.
paragraphs.zh: 语言模型是该方法的一部分，包括课程策略、对抗策略和执行策略、WebWorld-14B 世界模型、Qwen3.8-27B 评判器以及 Kimi-K3 评估对抗器。除了这些组件之外，我们还使用了生成式 AI 助手来协助实验设计、定性轨迹审计和结果解读，以支持文献检索和参考文献格式化，并用于起草文本、公式和图表，以及检查手稿中的内部不一致之处。我们并未使用生成式 AI 来完善研究假设，而数学证明和翻译则不适用于本研究。所有报告的数据均基于保存的实验记录计算得出，没有任何缺失的测量值被生成的数值所填补，且表 1、2、3 和 7 中的汇总比率均可通过表 5 中的每个种子运行次数重新计算得出。作者们审阅了所有由 AI 协助生成的内容，并对本文中的文本、论断及成果承担全部责任。

paragraphs.en: The trained adversary generates prompt injections intended to divert a web agent from its authorized task, and a page author could attempt to use such a policy against deployed agents. The released adversaries are low-rank adapters on a 4B model, trained and evaluated only on synthetic pages whose injections are rendered by a frozen web world model; we have not tested them against deployed agents or real websites, and there are no known deployments of the trained policies. We release them because a defense should be tested against an adversary that adapts to the defended agent, and our aim is to advance training procedures that such attacks cannot break. The work involves no human subjects. External grading and the Kimi-K3 evaluation send generated task and trajectory text to hosted inference providers, so applying the method to private data requires appropriate safeguards.
paragraphs.zh: 训练后的对抗智能体生成提示注入，旨在使网络智能体偏离其授权任务，而页面作者也可能尝试利用此类策略对抗已部署的智能体。我们发布的这些对抗模型是基于一款 4B 模型的低秩适配器，仅使用合成页面进行训练和评估；这些页面的注入内容由一个冻结的网络世界模型渲染。我们尚未在已部署的智能体或真实网站上测试过它们，目前也没有已知该训练策略的实际部署案例。我们之所以发布这些模型，是因为防御机制应当能够对抗那些会自适应受保护智能体的对手，而我们的目标是推动训练流程的发展，使其不会被此类攻击所破坏。本研究不涉及任何人类受试者。外部评分和 Kimi-K3 评估会将生成的任务及轨迹文本发送至托管的推理服务提供商，因此若要将该方法应用于私有数据，需采取适当的防护措施。

paragraphs.en: Reproducibility statement. Appendices D and C specify the update objective, the Stage-2 update order, the injection interface, and failure handling, together with the evaluation protocols for the world model, the Chromium transfer, the Kimi-K3 adversary, and the Stage-1 removal, the per-seed counts behind every reported rate, and the recorded training configuration. We release the code, the 150 benchmark tasks with their contracts, and all checkpoint results and trajectories. Three limits apply: attacked training continuations share the control’s prefix and seed but not the model servers’ random state; the hosted Qwen3.5-9B reference is available only as its recorded evaluation log, since we do not hold its served weights or raw trajectories; and Kimi-K3 is a hosted model whose served version may change.
paragraphs.zh: 可复现性声明。附录 D 和 C 规定了更新目标、阶段 2 的更新顺序、注入接口以及故障处理机制，同时还列出了世界模型、Chromium 迁移、Kimi-K3 对抗模型和阶段 1 移除的评估协议、每个报告比率背后的每种子运行次数，以及记录的训练配置。我们公开了代码、包含其约束条件的 150 个基准任务，以及所有检查点结果和轨迹。有三项限制适用：受攻击的训练延续共享控制器的前缀和种子，但不共享模型服务器的随机状态；托管的 Qwen3.5-9B 参考模型仅以记录好的评估日志形式提供，因为我们并不持有其服务权重或原始轨迹；而 Kimi-K3 是一个托管模型，其服务版本可能会发生变化。

paragraphs.en: The statistics below are recomputed from the 12,600 12{,}600 saved evaluation episodes of the seven local checkpoints in Table 1 (clean and Adv v1–v3, three seeds, 150 tasks); the recomputed judged completion rates equal every corresponding cell of that table.
paragraphs.zh: 以下统计数据是根据表 1 中七个本地检查点（clean 和 Adv v1–v3，三种种子，150 个任务）所保存的 12,600 个评估回合重新计算的；重新计算后的判断完成率与表中每个对应单元格的数据完全一致。

paragraphs.en: Each task pairs a goal of 51 to 76 words with an initial accessibility-tree page of 18 to 46 lines that holds the records and rules the task depends on, the form controls, two protected fields (Audit checksum and Internal note) that must stay untouched, and two forbidden controls (Save draft and Reset all). The 150 tasks instantiate ten templates in five skill strata, each with a low and a high difficulty tier and a short form (eight or nine fields) or a full form (twelve or thirteen fields), and each task ships a reference action sequence of 4, 5, 8, or 9 actions and an oracle contract that the browser check of Section 3 enforces ( Table 4 ). Conditional policy applies thresholded rules to one record, derived values requires arithmetic such as a rounded-up pack count or a two-decimal total, conjunctive selection asks for the cheapest row that meets every constraint, relational join follows a reference from one record to another, and ordered repair requires corrections followed by a review and a commit in a prescribed order; every task page is in the released benchmark.
paragraphs.zh: 每个任务都将一个包含 51 至 76 个词的目标，与一个初始的、包含 18 至 46 行的可访问性树页面进行配对。该页面存储了任务所依赖的记录和规则，包括表单控件、两个必须保持原样的受保护字段（审计校验和与内部说明），以及两个禁止使用的控件（保存草稿与全部重置）。这 150 个任务实例化了五个技能层级中的十个模板，每个模板均包含一个低难度层级和一个高难度层级，以及一个简短表单（八个或九个字段）或一个完整表单（十二个或十三个字段）。每个任务还附带一个参考操作序列（包含 4、5、8 或 9 个操作）和一个预言机合同，该合同由第 3 节的浏览器检查强制执行（表 4）。条件策略对一条记录应用阈值规则；派生值需要执行算术运算，例如向上取整的包装数量或保留两位小数的总计；联合选择要求找出满足所有约束的最便宜行；关系连接则遵循从一个记录到另一个记录的引用；有序修复则需要按预定顺序先进行修正，再进行审核并提交。所有任务页面均已包含在发布的基准测试中。

paragraphs.en: A clean episode records 7.41 7.41 actions on average, ends with a message to the user in 97.2 % 97.2\% of cases, and reaches the 12-action budget in 3.7 % 3.7\% ; under the learned adversaries these become 7.76 7.76 to 8.05 8.05 actions, 84.7 % 84.7\% to 88.6 % 88.6\% , and 13.0 % 13.0\% to 17.3 % 17.3\% , usually through a repeated fill or a click on a control that the injection named. Adv v1, v2, and v3 request an injection in 81.0 % 81.0\% , 66.5 % 66.5\% , and 78.6 % 78.6\% of episodes, with the median request at turn 2, 3, and 2, but the exact marker string they ask for is visible in the rendered page in under 0.5 % 0.5\% of episodes, so the marker is a delivery diagnostic and not a condition for counting an episode as attacked. Judged completion is 54.1 % 54.1\% , 41.0 % 41.0\% , and 46.2 % 46.2\% on episodes with an injection request against 73.2 % 73.2\% , 76.3 % 76.3\% , and 75.4 % 75.4\% without one; restricted to requested injections, the attack mean is 41.75 % 41.75\% for Base, 46.50 % 46.50\% for Capability iter 3, and 49.45 % 49.45\% for Robust iter 3, so the final clean-to-attacked gap is 31.88 31.88 points rather than 23.85 23.85 .
paragraphs.zh: 一个干净的流程平均记录 7.41 个动作，在 97.2% 的情况下以向用户发送消息结束，并在 3.7% 的情况下达到 12 次动作的预算；而在已学习的对抗样本下，这些数值分别变为 7.76 至 8.05 个动作、84.7% 至 88.6%，以及 13.0% 至 17.3%，通常通过重复填写或点击注入所命名的控件实现。Adv v1、v2 和 v3 在流程中的注入请求比例分别为 81.0%、66.5% 和 78.6%，其中请求的中位数出现在第 2、3 和第 2 轮，但它们所要求的确切标记字符串在渲染页面中出现的比例低于 0.5%，因此该标记是交付的诊断指标，而非将流程计为受攻击的条件。对于包含注入请求的流程，判断完成的比率分别为 54.1%、41.0% 和 46.2%；而不包含注入请求的流程中，这一比率分别为 73.2%、76.3% 和 75.4%；若仅限于有注入请求的流程，攻击成功率的平均值对于 Base 为 41.75%，对于 Capability iter 3 为 46.50%，对于 Robust iter 3 为 49.45%，因此最终干净流程与受攻击流程之间的差距为 31.88 个百分点，而非 23.85 个百分点。

paragraphs.en: Of the 9,449 9{,}449 resolved pairs of a clean and an attacked episode with the same executor, task, and seed, 48.9 % 48.9\% are judged good in both, 16.6 % 16.6\% bad in both, and 29.1 % 29.1\% flip from clean good to attacked bad; the reverse flip, 5.5 % 5.5\% of pairs, measures rollout variance. In 13.4 % 13.4\% of the flips the executor took the same actions in both episodes except its final message, so the verdict changed with its report, for example when, after an injected warning, the world model answers the submit click with a “Submission blocked” notice that the executor relays. Among pairs whose clean episode is judged good, the attacked episode fails for Base in 39.8 % 39.8\% , 42.4 % 42.4\% , and 46.0 % 46.0\% of cases against Adv v1, v2, and v3, and for Robust iter 3 in 30.6 % 30.6\% , 39.1 % 39.1\% , and 37.2 % 37.2\% ( Figure 5 c).
paragraphs.zh: 在 9,449 个由同一执行者、任务和种子生成的干净与受攻击剧集的已解决配对中，有 48.9% 的配对在两种情况下都被判定为良好，16.6% 的配对在两种情况下都被判定为不良，另有 29.1% 的配对从“干净良好”转变为“受攻击不良”；而反向转变的配对占 5.5%，这一比例反映了展开过程的方差。在这些转变中，有 13.4% 的情况是执行者在两个剧集中都采取了相同的行动，仅最终消息不同，因此判定结果随其报告而改变。例如，在注入警告后，世界模型对“提交”点击的回应会显示一条“提交被阻止”的通知，而执行者会将该通知转达出去。在干净剧集被判定为良好的配对中，受攻击剧集在 Base 模型上的失败率分别为：针对 Adv v1、v2 和 v3 时，失败率依次为 39.8%、42.4% 和 46.0%；而在 Robust iter 3 上，失败率则为 30.6%、39.1% 和 37.2%（图 5c）。

paragraphs.en: This analysis uses the 3,150 3{,}150 saved clean episodes of the seven local checkpoints (150 tasks, three seeds); it makes no new model calls, changes no judge label, and excludes the hosted 9B model, whose trajectories were not transferred.
paragraphs.zh: 本次分析使用了七个本地检查点中保存的 3,150 个干净回合（150 项任务，三个种子）；它没有进行任何新的模型调用，也没有更改任何评判标签，并且排除了托管的 9B 模型，因为其轨迹并未被转移。

paragraphs.en: For each task we count its good judgments over the three seeds and call it improved, tied, or regressed after an update by the sign of the change; this compares 150 task identities, not 450 independent samples. Every update both improves and regresses tasks ( Figure 5 b): each Stage-1 update improves 23 to 28 tasks and regresses 19 to 21, and the final Robust update gains 15 good judgments through 48 bad-to-good and 33 good-to-bad changes on matched task and seed. These are changes in judged trajectories; inspected seed-0 traces show changed actions, such as a correct dispatch choice on task 7 after Capability iter 1 and a completed refund on task 80 after Capability iter 3, but do not show that the policy acquired a named skill.
paragraphs.zh: 对于每个任务，我们都会统计其在三个种子运行中的有效判断次数，并根据更新后的变化符号将其判定为“改进”、“持平”或“退化”；此过程比较的是150个任务实例，而非450个独立样本。每次更新都会同时使部分任务得到改进、部分任务出现退化（图5b）：每个阶段1的更新会使23至28项任务得到改进，而19至21项任务则出现退化；最终的“稳健”更新则通过匹配的任务和种子运行，在48次“无效判断转为有效判断”的变化和33次“有效判断转为无效判断”的变化中，获得了15个有效判断。这些是已判定轨迹的变化；对种子0轨迹的审查显示，某些动作发生了变化，例如在能力迭代第1轮后，任务7出现了正确的派遣选择，而在能力迭代第3轮后，任务80完成了退款操作，但这并未表明策略本身获得了某种命名的技能。

paragraphs.en: Conjunctive selection is the hardest stratum at every checkpoint, and the high tier is harder in every condition: Base completes 83.0 % 83.0\% of low-tier and 63.4 % 63.4\% of high-tier tasks clean, and Robust iter 3 90.9 % 90.9\% and 67.7 % 67.7\% . From Capability iter 3 to Robust iter 3, derived values rises from 63.33 % 63.33\% to 86.67 % 86.67\% and conditional policy from 82.96 % 82.96\% to 86.67 % 86.67\% , while conjunctive selection, ordered repair, and relational join decline ( Figure 5 a), so an aggregate gain does not imply a gain in every stratum. Base solves 95 of the 150 tasks in all three seeds and 22 in none, and Robust iter 3 solves 108 and 15.
paragraphs.zh: 联合选择是各个检查点中最难的一层，而且在所有条件下，高层都更难：Base 在低层任务中的干净完成率为 83.0 % 83.0\%，高层任务中为 63.4 % 63.4\%；而 Robust iter 3 的完成率分别为 90.9 % 90.9\% 和 67.7 % 67.7\%。从 Capability iter 3 到 Robust iter 3，衍生值从 63.33 % 63.33\% 上升到 86.67 % 86.67\%，条件策略也从 82.96 % 82.96\% 上升到 86.67 % 86.67\%；但联合选择、有序修复和关系连接却有所下降（图 5a），因此整体增益并不意味着每一层都有提升。Base 在所有三个种子中解决了 150 个任务中的 95 个，但没有解决其中任何 22 个；而 Robust iter 3 则分别解决了 108 个和 15 个。

paragraphs.en: Table 5 gives the numerators behind Tables 1 , 2 and 7 ; rates average the three seed fractions before averaging adversaries. On matched task, seed, and condition identities with the hosted model, Robust iter 3 has an attack mean of 57.40 % 57.40\% ; the remaining trajectories and generated attacks are not identical across models.
paragraphs.zh: 表 5 给出了表 1、表 2 和表 7 中的分子；在平均对抗者之前，这些比率是对三种种子分数进行平均的结果。在与托管模型的任务、种子和条件身份相匹配的情况下，Robust iter 3 的攻击均值为 57.40% 57.40\%；其余的轨迹和生成的攻击在不同模型之间并不相同。

paragraphs.en: Table 6 lists every value in Figure 4 that Tables 1 and 7 do not print.
paragraphs.zh: 表 6 列出了图 4 中所有表 1 和表 7 未打印的值。

paragraphs.en: Table 2 reports clean Chromium runs of Base and Capability iter 1–3 on the 150 tasks, three seeds each ( 1,800 1{,}800 episodes), with no world-model call.
paragraphs.zh: 表 2 报告了 Base 和 Capability 在迭代 1–3 期间对 150 项任务进行的干净 Chromium 运行结果，每种情况使用三个种子（1,800 个回合），且未调用世界模型。

paragraphs.en: Protocol. The evaluator renders each task’s accessibility-tree page as HTML, serves it to a fresh browser context, and gives the executor the frozen initial page followed by live observations derived from the DOM. The executor keeps the world-model system prompt, action language, and history format; each action string is bound to a typed Playwright operation, and an action whose arguments do not match the declared contract is rejected and recorded rather than silently repaired. Policy requests use temperature 0.7 0.7 , at most 256 output tokens, and seeds 0, 1, and 2; the budget is 12 recorded actions and at most 11 applied transitions. Strict success requires an actual submission whose final form values match the task contract and whose workflow invariants hold: protected fields untouched, forbidden controls never activated, and a review before commit where required. Field accuracy counts correct values among the 746 target fields per seed. The judge is the same Qwen3.8-27B trajectory judge as in the world-model evaluation and reads the recorded browser trajectory; reference solutions and scoring metadata are attached only after the browser session closes.
paragraphs.zh: 协议。评估器将每个任务的无障碍树页面渲染为 HTML，将其提供给一个新的浏览器上下文，并向执行者提供冻结的初始页面以及随后从 DOM 中获取的实时观察信息。执行者保留世界模型系统提示、操作语言和历史记录格式；每个操作字符串都与一个带类型的 Playwright 操作绑定，若某个操作的参数与声明的合同不匹配，则会被拒绝并记录，而非静默修复。策略请求使用温度 0.7 0.7，最多输出 256 个令牌，并使用种子值 0、1 和 2；预算为 12 个记录的操作和最多 11 个应用的状态转换。严格成功要求必须有一次实际提交，其最终表单值需符合任务合同，且工作流程不变量必须成立：受保护字段未被篡改，禁止操作从未被激活，以及在需要时提交前进行了审核。字段准确性在每个种子值下针对 746 个目标字段中的正确值进行统计。评判器与世界模型评估中使用的相同 Qwen3.8-27B 轨迹评判器一致，并读取记录下来的浏览器轨迹；参考解决方案和评分元数据仅在浏览器会话关闭后才会附加。

paragraphs.en: Where the gain comes from. From Base to Capability iter 3, strict success rises by 27.2 27.2 , 25.4 25.4 , and 20.0 20.0 points on relational join, ordered repair, and conditional policy, and by 25.8 25.8 and 25.0 25.0 points on low-tier and short-form tasks against 9.1 9.1 and 12.6 12.6 on high-tier and full-form tasks ( Figure 6 a,b). Conjunctive selection passes the strict check in none of its 60 episodes at any checkpoint, although the world-model judge accepts 40.0 % 40.0\% to 58.3 % 58.3\% of them, and two-decimal money amounts stay the weakest field type ( 23.7 % 23.7\% to 40.2 % 40.2\% correct, against 59.9 % 59.9\% to 81.7 % 81.7\% for text fields).
paragraphs.zh: 收益从何而来？从“基础”到“能力”迭代3，严格成功率在关系连接、有序修复和条件策略方面分别提升了27.2分、25.4分和20.0分；在低层级和短形式任务上分别提升了25.8分和25.0分，而在高层级和完整形式任务上则仅提升了9.1分和12.6分（图6a、b）。在所有60个回合中，合取选择在任何检查点均未通过严格检验，尽管世界模型判定器接受了其中40.0%至58.3%的样本；而两位小数的货币金额仍然是最弱的字段类型（正确率从23.7%到40.2%，相比之下文本字段的正确率为59.9%至81.7%）。

paragraphs.en: How episodes fail. A submitted form with at least one wrong value is the largest outcome class at every checkpoint ( 58.0 % 58.0\% of Base and 50.7 % 50.7\% of Capability iter 3 episodes), while episodes that never submit fall from 16.2 % 16.2\% to 2.0 % 2.0\% and budget stops from 96 to 13 of 450, so Stage 1 mainly teaches the executor to finish the workflow ( Figure 6 c). Episodes with a rejected action fall from 132 to 67 of 450, mostly the literal press_enter passed as the third argument of fill , which the world model accepts and the browser contract rejects (121 and 58 episodes), but only 0.2 % 0.2\% to 2.9 % 2.9\% of episodes fail solely because of a rejected action.
paragraphs.zh: 任务集失败的原因。在每一个检查点中，至少有一个值错误的已提交表单都是最大的结果类别（Base 任务集中占 58.0%（58.0\%），Capability 迭代 3 的任务集中占 50.7%（50.7\%）），而从未提交的任务集比例则从 16.2%（16.2\%）降至 2.0%（2.0\%），预算停止次数也从 450 次中的 96 次降至 13 次，因此第一阶段主要教导执行者完成工作流程（图 6c）。包含被拒绝操作的任务集数量从 450 个中 132 个降至 67 个，其中大多数是字面意义上的 press_enter 被作为 fill 的第三个参数传递，世界模型接受了该参数，但浏览器契约却拒绝了它（分别涉及 121 个和 58 个任务集），然而仅有 0.2%（0.2\%）至 2.9%（2.9\%）的任务集是仅因操作被拒绝而失败。

paragraphs.en: Judge, world model, and browser. No browser episode passes the strict check while judged bad, but the judge accepts 7.5 % 7.5\% to 10.4 % 10.4\% of the trajectories that fail it, so judged completion upper-bounds strict completion and ranks the four checkpoints in the same order ( Table 5 ). Per task and seed, 35.6 % 35.6\% to 51.8 % 51.8\% of pairs succeed only in the world model and 0.9 % 0.9\% to 2.4 % 2.4\% only in the browser ( Table 6 c); for Capability iter 3, 29 of the 67 tasks that never pass strictly are judged good in all three world-model seeds, 12 of them conditional policy, 9 conjunctive selection, and 5 derived values ( Figure 6 d). The two environments share tasks, starting pages, checkpoints, seeds, prompt, and budget but differ in action parsing, observation format, and grading, and this evaluation does not separate these causes.
paragraphs.zh: 裁判器、世界模型和浏览器。没有任何浏览器实验轮次能通过严格检查而被判定为不合格，但裁判器接受了其中 7.5%（7.5\%）至 10.4%（10.4\%）的失败轨迹，因此，经裁判判定的完成度上限高于严格完成度，且四个检查点的排名顺序一致（表 5）。按任务和种子计算，35.6%（35.6\%）至 51.8%（51.8\%）的成对实验仅在世界模型中成功，而仅在浏览器中成功的比例则为 0.9%（0.9\%）至 2.4%（2.4\%）（表 6c）。对于 Capability iter 3，在从未通过严格检查的 67 项任务中，有 29 项在所有三种世界模型种子中均被判定为良好，其中 12 项为条件策略，9 项为联合选择，5 项为派生值（图 6d）。这两个环境共享任务、起始页面、检查点、种子、提示词和预算，但在动作解析、观察格式和评分标准上存在差异，而本次评估并未区分这些原因。

paragraphs.en: Protocol. Kimi-K3 replaces the learned adversary in the evaluation loop of Table 1 ; the executor checkpoints, the world model, the judge, the 150 tasks, and every decoding setting are unchanged. Before each world-model transition the model receives the system prompt of Adv v1–v3 and the same user message with the goal, the current page, and the executor’s pending action. It either declines to inject or returns one injection request naming the injected instruction, the text that marks it on the page, and the page element that carries it. Sampling uses temperature 1.0 1.0 , at most 256 output tokens, and a fixed seed per task and turn. The model’s extended reasoning mode is disabled so that the reply fits the token budget, and it is queried at most 11 times per episode. The world model renders at most one injection per trajectory, exactly as for the learned adversaries, and the judge sees the resulting trajectory without being told which adversary produced it. The adversary and judge calls for this evaluation cost under $40 in API charges. Runs use seeds 0 and 1; seed 2 was stopped after rate-limit errors, and 293 of the 300 Robust iter 3 episodes received a verdict.
paragraphs.zh: 协议。Kimi-K3 替换了表 1 中评估循环里经过学习的对抗智能体；执行器、世界模型、评判者、150 项任务以及所有解码设置均保持不变。在每次世界模型状态转换之前，该模型会接收 Adv v1–v3 的系统提示，以及包含目标、当前页面和执行器待执行操作的相同用户消息。它要么拒绝注入，要么返回一个注入请求，其中需指明所注入的指令、页面上标记该指令的文本以及承载该指令的页面元素。采样时使用温度 1.0、最多 256 个输出标记，并为每个任务和轮次设置固定种子。模型的高级推理模式被禁用，以确保回复符合标记预算限制，且每轮最多被查询 11 次。世界模型在每个轨迹中最多渲染一次注入，与经过学习的对抗智能体的做法完全一致；评判者在查看生成的轨迹时不会被告知是由哪个对抗智能体产生的。此次评估中，对抗智能体和评判者的 API 调用费用低于 40 美元。运行使用了种子 0 和 1；种子 2 因速率限制错误而中止，300 次 Robust iter 3 轮次中有 293 次获得了判定结果。

paragraphs.en: Injection behavior. Kimi-K3 requests an injection in 95.0 % 95.0\% to 98.0 % 98.0\% of episodes, with the median request at turn 3 against Base, Robust iter 1, and Robust iter 2 and at turn 2 against Robust iter 3 ( Table 6 b). Base ends 28.3 % 28.3\% of its episodes without a final message and the Robust checkpoints 14.0 % 14.0\% to 15.4 % 15.4\% , against 11.4 % 11.4\% to 15.3 % 15.3\% under the learned adversaries.
paragraphs.zh: 注入行为。在 95.0% 至 98.0% 的回合中，Kimi-K3 都会请求注入，其中与 Base、Robust iter 1 和 Robust iter 2 相比，请求的中位数出现在第 3 轮；而与 Robust iter 3 相比，则出现在第 2 轮（表 6b）。Base 在 28.3% 的回合中未发出最终消息即结束，而 Robust 检查点的这一比例为 14.0% 至 15.4%，相比之下，在已学习的对抗样本下，该比例为 11.4% 至 15.3%。

paragraphs.en: The Stage-2-only branch trains three executors without Stage 1 and is evaluated clean and against the with-Stage-1 Adv v1–v3 on the same tasks and seeds ( 1,350 1{,}350 clean and 4,050 4{,}050 attacked episodes; counts in Table 5 ), with the prompt, budget, and judge of Section 5 . Configured rounds, proposal positions, and epochs match the complete pipeline, but retained tasks, optimizer updates, and compute are not controlled, the two branches’ training histories diverge, and reactive injections can differ across executors at the same task, seed, and adversary checkpoint. Adapters and adversaries are pinned to fixed release revisions recorded with the saved records.
paragraphs.zh: 仅包含第 2 阶段的分支在不使用第 1 阶段的情况下训练三个执行器，并在相同任务和种子（1,350 个干净样本和 4,050 个受攻击样本；具体数量见第 5 表）上，结合第 5 节的提示、预算和评判标准，分别对干净样本以及包含第 1 阶段的 Adv v1–v3 进行评估。配置的轮数、提案位置和训练周期与完整流程一致，但保留的任务、优化器更新和计算资源不受控制，因此两个分支的训练历史会出现分歧，并且在同一任务、种子和对抗检查点上，不同执行器的反应性注入也可能存在差异。适配器和对抗模块则被锁定在随保存记录一同记录的固定发布版本上。

paragraphs.en: These measurements describe one recorded Stage-1 execution; they are not held-out scores and do not cover the full checkpoint sequence of Table 1 . It used Qwen3.5-4B role policies, the frozen WebWorld-14B, and the Qwen3.8-27B judge; LoRA rank 16 16 and scaling 32 32 , learning rate 10 − 5 10^{-5} , and KL coefficient 0.01 0.01 ; 150 150 proposal positions in each of two pools, K = 6 K=6 assessment rollouts, one curriculum epoch, and two executor epochs of 75 updates, each on six trajectories for each of two tasks; and two 96 GB RTX 6000 Pro GPUs with gradient checkpointing, micro-batch size one, and a 4,096-token cap. Its action limit was eight and its judge capped each subsequent page at 1,500 characters, unlike the 12-action evaluation and the uncapped Stage-2 judge. In the first executor update, 178 of 300 task groups had uniform rewards and hence zero advantage; the summed update time was 11.02 11.02 hours, and the first iteration held two GPUs for 20 h 46 min, or 41.54 41.54 allocated GPU-hours, which measures reservation rather than utilization; token use, API charges, and active device time were not measured.
paragraphs.zh: 这些测量值描述了已记录的一次阶段1执行过程；它们并非预留的得分，也未涵盖表1中的完整检查点序列。该执行过程使用了Qwen3.5-4B角色策略、冻结的WebWorld-14B模型以及Qwen3.8-27B评判器；LoRA秩为16 16，缩放因子为32 32，学习率为10⁻⁵ 10^{-5}，KL系数为0.01 0.01；两个池中每个池包含150 150个提议位置，K = 6 K=6次评估展开，一个课程学习周期，以及两个执行器周期（各含75次更新），每个周期针对两项任务中的每项任务运行六个轨迹；此外还使用了两台96 GB的RTX 6000 Pro GPU，并启用了梯度检查点机制，微批量大小为1，最大令牌数为4,096。其动作限制为8，且评判器对后续每一页的内容上限设为1,500个字符，这与包含12个动作的评估以及无上限的阶段2评判器不同。在第一次执行器更新中，300个任务组中有178个具有均匀奖励，因此优势为零；总更新时间为11.02 11.02小时，第一次迭代持续使用了两台GPU共20小时46分钟，即41.54 41.54个分配GPU-小时（该指标衡量的是预留时间而非实际使用时长）；令牌使用量、API费用及活跃设备运行时间均未进行测量。

paragraphs.en: Structural scans found repeated element identifiers in 5 / 150 5/150 first-iteration curriculum pages and 3 / 150 3/150 executor-pool pages ( 4 / 150 4/150 and 6 / 149 6/149 in the second iteration), and one of 150 second-iteration proposals failed validation. The judge also mislabels arithmetic: two trajectories that submitted 10,102 10{,}102 and 8,862 8{,}862 instead of 21,042 21{,}042 received positive labels, and in a second task all six trajectories were labeled positive despite totals different from 446.04 446.04 , with the wrong values visible in the judge input; these selected cases establish reward error but not its frequency. The Stage-1 judge’s 1,500-character page cap also omitted filled fields in inspected negative trajectories.
paragraphs.zh: 结构扫描在首轮课程计划的 5 / 150 5/150 个页面和 3 / 150 3/150 个执行器池页面中发现了重复的元素标识符（第二轮迭代中分别为 4 / 150 4/150 和 6 / 149 6/149），且第二轮迭代的一个提案未能通过验证。评判器还对算术计算进行了错误标记：两条轨迹分别提交了 10,102 10{,}102 和 8,862 8{,}862，而非正确的 21,042 21{,}042，却获得了正向标签；在另一项任务中，尽管六个轨迹的总和均不等于 446.04 446.04，且评判器输入中显示的是错误数值，但所有六个轨迹都被标记为正向。这些选中的案例证实了奖励机制存在错误，但无法确定其发生频率。此外，第一阶段评判器设定的 1,500 字符页面限制也导致所检查的负向轨迹中被填写的字段被遗漏。

paragraphs.en: Three rollout seeds of one trained adapter per checkpoint measure rollout variance, not training variance, and we report no confidence intervals. We do not hold the hosted 9B reference’s served weights or raw trajectories, so its comparison cannot be re-run under a different adversary or audited at the trajectory level. None of these results certify robustness against arbitrary page authors or transfer to browser execution, visual observations, or unseen websites.
paragraphs.zh: 每个检查点中，针对单个训练好的适配器进行三次展开种子运行，用于衡量展开方差而非训练方差，且我们未报告任何置信区间。我们不保留所托管的 9B 参考模型的服务权重或原始轨迹，因此无法在不同对抗者条件下重新执行该比较，也无法在轨迹层面进行审计。这些结果均未证明模型对任意页面作者的鲁棒性，也未证明其能迁移到浏览器执行、视觉观察或未见的网站上。

paragraphs.en: This appendix specifies the update objective, the Stage-2 update order, the attack interface, and failure handling; the recorded run’s configuration is in Section C.6 .
paragraphs.zh: 本附录规定了更新目标、第 2 阶段的更新顺序、攻击接口以及故障处理机制；所记录运行实例的配置信息见第 C.6 节。

paragraphs.en: The judge checks the authorized goal against the recorded trajectory, and a closing assertion of success does not suffice under its rubric; evaluation gives it no gold action sequence or generated reference. Historical Stage-1 assessments assign zero after three consecutive identical actions, whereas Stage 2 uses the judge verdict alone. Each trajectory yields a terminal outcome key, the label of its last click with the last value entered in each field; the validity gate ν ⁡ ( x ) \nu(x) of Equation 3 equals 1 1 when p ^ J ​ ( x ) > 0.1 \widehat{p}_{J}(x)>0.1 and at least one good trajectory has a key, and the most common key among good trajectories is stored as the task’s reference outcome.
paragraphs.zh: 裁判官会将授权目标与记录好的轨迹进行比对，并且根据其评判标准，仅给出一个成功的最终断言并不足够；评估过程不会提供黄金动作序列或生成的参考。历史性的阶段1评估中，若出现连续三个相同的动作，则赋值为零，而阶段2则仅使用裁判官的裁决。每条轨迹都会产生一个终端结果键，即其最后一次点击所对应的标签以及每个字段中输入的最后一个值；方程3中的有效性门限 ν ⁡ ( x ) \nu(x) 在 p ^ J ​ ( x ) > 0.1 \widehat{p}_{J}(x)>0.1 且至少有一条有效轨迹拥有结果键时等于 1 1，而有效轨迹中最常见的结果键将被存储为该任务的参考结果。
