paragraphs.en: The mask selects generated proposal tokens for the curriculum and adversary and generated assistant tokens for the executor, so world-model observations supply context without a prediction loss, and normalizing by N N weights longer completions more. Advantages subtract the comparison-group mean and divide by its population standard deviation plus 10 − 6 10^{-6} ; executor advantages then apply the difficulty scale of Equation 4 . The update keeps GRPO’s group normalization but omits its old-policy likelihood ratio and clipped surrogate ( Shao et al., 2024 ) , and curriculum replay has no importance correction for proposals generated before later adapter updates. Curriculum groups are stratified by stored base reward; lexical clusters use normalized text, a greedy representative, and similarity threshold 0.8 0.8 , which does not establish semantic diversity, and the curriculum penalty includes a singleton floor λ C / | 𝒫 | \lambda_{C}/|\mathcal{P}| that the adversary penalty subtracts. Adversary groups contain M M candidates for the same task, each scored against its K K controls; a group with identical rewards has zero advantage, although the penalty term and optimizer state can still change parameters. Each invocation loads the role’s previous adapter, initializes a fresh AdamW optimizer, and saves a new adapter; Stage 2 freezes the selected Stage-1 curriculum, starts its executor from the selected Stage-1 executor and its adversary from the base model, and continues each role’s own adapter without merging weights.
paragraphs.zh: 该掩码为课程和对抗智能体选择生成的提议标记，为执行器选择生成的助手标记，因此世界模型观察可提供上下文而不会产生预测损失，并且通过归一化，长度更长的补全会获得更高的 N N 权重。优势值通过减去比较组的均值，再除以该组总体标准差加上 10 − 6 10^{-6} 来计算；随后，执行器的优势值将应用方程 4 中的难度缩放因子。更新过程保留了 GRPO 的组归一化方法，但省略了其旧策略似然比和截断代理损失（Shao et al., 2024），并且课程重播不会对在后续适配器更新之前生成的提议进行重要性校正。课程组根据存储的基础奖励进行分层；词汇簇使用归一化的文本、一个贪婪代表以及 0.8 0.8 的相似度阈值，但这并未建立语义多样性，且课程惩罚项包含一个单元素下限 λ C / | 𝒫 | \lambda_{C}/|\mathcal{P}|，对抗惩罚项会将其减去。对抗组包含同一任务的 M M 个候选项，每个候选项都针对其 K K 个对照项进行评分；若某组内的奖励完全相同，则其优势值为零，尽管惩罚项和优化器状态仍可能改变参数。每次调用都会加载该角色的先前适配器、初始化一个新的 AdamW 优化器，并保存一个新的适配器；阶段 2 会冻结已选择的阶段 1 课程，从已选择的阶段 1 执行器和基础模型分别启动其执行器和对抗智能体，并且在不合并权重的情况下继续每个角色自身的适配器训练。

paragraphs.en: Algorithm 2 specifies one Stage-2 round; M M counts attack candidates per task, K K clean controls per task, and G G fresh executor trajectories per training visit. The first clean collection screens tasks at η = 0.5 \eta=0.5 and the second saves the histories from which attacked continuations are forked, so a screened task can still lack a successful control; the adversary prompt never sees the controls or their verdicts. The executor mixture requests fresh, historical, and clean shares of 0.50 0.50 , 0.25 0.25 , and 0.25 0.25 , keeps every distinct fresh attack, samples the rest without replacement and without padding by duplication (the first round has no historical attacks), and draws clean practice from all deduplicated proposals, including those below the screen.
paragraphs.zh: 算法 2 定义了一个阶段 2 的轮次；M M 统计每个任务的攻击候选者数量，K K 为每个任务统计干净控制样本的数量，G G 则统计每次训练访问中获得的新鲜执行者轨迹数量。第一次干净收集在 η = 0.5 \eta=0.5 的阈值下筛选任务，而第二次收集则保存用于分叉出受攻击后续步骤的历史记录，因此一个经过筛选的任务仍可能没有成功的控制样本；对抗性提示永远不会看到这些控制样本或它们的判定结果。执行者混合机制请求新鲜、历史及干净样本的比例分别为 0.50、0.25 和 0.25，保留每一个独特的新鲜攻击，其余样本则通过无放回抽样且不通过重复填充的方式抽取（第一轮没有历史攻击），并从所有去重后的提案中抽取干净的练习样本，包括那些未通过筛选的提案。

paragraphs.en: Proposal parsing. A proposal α = ( z , m , d , ζ ) \alpha=(z,m,d,\zeta) is valid when its instruction z z and marker m m are nonempty; the target action ζ \zeta is optional, a missing, nonmatching, or zero transition index becomes one, and a malformed proposal receives − 1 -1 . The parser does not check that d d is reachable, that the marker is novel, or that the target conflicts with the goal; an unreachable transition yields no injection and no success-flip credit in Equation 5 .
paragraphs.zh: 提案解析。一个提案 α = ( z , m , d , ζ ) \alpha=(z,m,d,\zeta) 是有效的，当其指令 z z 和标记 m m 非空；目标动作 ζ \zeta 是可选的，缺失、不匹配或为零的转换索引将变为 1，而格式错误的提案则得到 − 1 -1。解析器不会检查 d d 是否可达、标记是否新颖，或目标是否与目标状态冲突；不可达的转换不会在方程 5 中产生注入或成功翻转奖励。

paragraphs.en: Rendering gate. The attacked observation must contain at least 40 stripped characters, a RootWebArea label or bracketed element identifier, and the normalized marker or at least 60 % 60\% of its tokens longer than two characters; the gate checks structure and text only, not that the task’s controls survive or that the executor complies.
paragraphs.zh: 渲染门。受攻击的观察内容必须包含至少 40 个剥离字符、一个 RootWebArea 标签或带括号的元素标识符，以及标准化标记或长度超过两个字符的标记中至少有 60%（60\%）的部分；该门仅检查结构和文本，不验证任务的控制项是否保留或执行者是否遵守规则。

paragraphs.en: Executor reward shaping. A good verdict receives + 1 +1 and a bad verdict without a declared target − 1 -1 ; for a bad verdict with target ζ \zeta , the reward is clip [ − 1 , 1 ] ⁡ ( − w g + w r ​ ( 1 − 2 ​ F ) ) \operatorname{clip}_{[-1,1]}(-w_{g}+w_{r}(1-2F)) , where F ∈ { 0 , 1 } F\in\{0,1\} indicates that the executor followed ζ \zeta , and the default w g = w r = 0.5 w_{g}=w_{r}=0.5 gives 0 0 to a failure that avoids the target and − 1 -1 to one that follows it. A target with a quoted value requires that value as well as the action.
paragraphs.zh: 执行者奖励塑造。一个良好的裁决获得 +1，而一个未声明目标的不良裁决则获得 −1；对于带有目标 ζ 的不良裁决，奖励为 clip[−1,1](−w_g + w_r(1−2F))，其中 F∈{0,1} 表示执行者是否遵循了 ζ，默认情况下 w_g = w_r = 0.5，因此对于未达成目标但避免了该目标的失败情况，奖励为 0；而对于遵循了该目标的失败情况，奖励为 −1。一个带有引用值的目标需要同时提供该值以及相应的动作。

paragraphs.en: Saved controls and reactive evaluation. Each clean control stores deep copies of the executor and world-model histories at reachable transition boundaries; an attacked continuation keeps the observed prefix, the selected action, the remaining budget, and the sampling seed, but not model-server state, so prefixes are aligned without identical stochastic continuations. Controls are reused within one adversary invocation and regenerated for the next. At evaluation the frozen adversary instead sees the goal, the current page, and the selected action before each transition and returns a wait or an injection; the first accepted injection ends further queries whether or not the world model renders it, and only transport failures are retried.
paragraphs.zh: 已保存的控制与反应式评估。每个干净控制都会在执行器和世界模型历史在可达转换边界处的深拷贝；受攻击的延续会保留观察到的前缀、所选动作、剩余预算和采样种子，但不会保留模型服务器的状态，因此前缀是对齐的，但随机延续并不完全相同。控制会在同一对抗方调用中重复使用，并在下一次调用时重新生成。在评估阶段，被冻结的对抗方会在每次转换前看到目标、当前页面和所选动作，并返回“等待”或“注入”；首次被接受的注入会终止后续查询，无论世界模型是否将其渲染出来，并且只有传输失败才会重试。

paragraphs.en: Trajectory evidence and failures. The Stage-2 collector records at most H H executor actions and H − 1 H-1 world transitions for budget H H , and the judge receives the parsed actions and their observations, not a reconstruction of browser state. Executor optimization keeps the most recent 4,096 tokens and curriculum replay at most 1,024 completion tokens, while each reward comes from the complete rollout. An assessment is published only when all its judgments resolve, the adversary update requires error-free controls and attacked rollouts with resolved verdicts, so an infrastructure failure cannot earn attack credit, and executor training drops unusable attempts and groups with fewer than two survivors; a judge-cache match shows input reuse, not a correct label.
paragraphs.zh: 轨迹证据与故障。在预算为 H 的情况下，阶段 2 收集器最多记录 H 个执行器动作和 H−1 个世界状态转换；而评判者接收的是解析后的动作及其观察结果，而非浏览器状态的重建版本。执行器优化会保留最近的 4,096 个词元，课程重播最多保留 1,024 个完成词元，而每次奖励均来自完整的展开过程。只有当所有判断结果都确定时，评估才会被发布；对抗性更新需要无错误的控制以及带有已确定裁决的被攻击展开过程，因此基础设施故障无法获得攻击积分。执行器训练会丢弃不可用的尝试以及幸存者少于两个的组别；若评判者缓存出现匹配，则表明输入被重复使用，而非标签正确。

paragraphs.en: Adversarial training for indirect injection. ARLAS co-trains an injection attacker and a defending agent as a zero-sum game against all earlier attacker checkpoints in BrowserGym and AgentDojo, which execute the agent’s actions ( Wang et al., 2025c ) ; we share its alternating updates and retention of earlier attacks and differ in (i) the environment, a frozen web world model, (ii) the attacker reward, which requires a rendered injection to flip a judged success on a saved clean control ( Equation 5 ), and (iii) the retained object, stored attack inputs relabeled by fresh rollouts rather than attacker checkpoints. CoER keeps opponent populations of both roles, allows repeated injections, and refines the defender on verified demonstrations ( Zhang et al., 2026 ) , GPT-Red trains a red-teaming agent against simultaneously trained defenders at post-training scale ( Wallace et al., 2026 ) , and RETA trains its defender on attacks archived against a frozen defender ( He et al., 2026 ) ; we allow one injection per trajectory, have no refinement stage, and use a single 4B adversary and executor. Preference and delimiter defenses train on a fixed injected dataset ( Chen et al., 2025b ; Chen et al., 2025c ; Wallace et al., 2024 ; Chen et al., 2025a ) ; a SecAlign-style control on the same backbone would test whether a changing attacker is needed.
paragraphs.zh: 间接注入的对抗性训练。ARLAS将注入攻击者与防御智能体共同训练为零和博弈，以对抗BrowserGym和AgentDojo中所有先前的攻击者检查点，这些检查点负责执行智能体的动作（Wang等，2025c）；我们共享其交替更新机制以及对先前攻击的保留策略，但存在以下差异：(i) 环境为冻结的网络世界模型；(ii) 攻击者奖励要求通过渲染出的注入操作，使已保存的干净控制样本的判断结果发生翻转（方程5）；(iii) 保留的对象为存储的攻击输入，这些输入由新的运行结果重新标注，而非由攻击者检查点标注。CoER同时保留两种角色的对手群体，允许重复注入，并在验证过的演示数据上对防御者进行优化（Zhang等，2026）；GPT-Red则在训练后规模上训练一个红队智能体，以对抗同步训练的防御者（Wallace等，2026）；RETA则使用针对冻结防御者存档的攻击数据来训练其防御者（He等，2026）。我们允许每条轨迹仅进行一次注入，没有优化阶段，并使用单个4B规模的对抗者和执行者。偏好与分隔符防御方法则在固定的注入数据集上进行训练（Chen等，2025b；Chen等，2025c；Wallace等，2024；Chen等，2025a）；若在同一主干模型上采用SecAlign风格的控制策略，则可检验是否需要引入可变化的攻击者。

paragraphs.en: Learning inside a web world model. Following World Models ( Ha and Schmidhuber, 2018 ) , WMA and WebDreamer plan with a web world model ( Chae et al., 2025 ; Gu et al., 2024 ) , WebEvolver trains it together with the policy ( Fang et al., 2025 ) , and DreamGym trains a policy online in an experience model and tests transfer to real environments ( Chen et al., 2026b ) ; we inherit WebWorld’s predicted pages unchanged ( Xiao et al., 2026 ) and add the proposer, the judge-derived rewards, and the adversarial stage. WebRL, the closest browser-executed loop, derives tasks from failed attempts and scores them with a learned reward model ( Qi et al., 2025 ) , and AgentGym-RL and AgentTrek learn from executed actions ( Xi et al., 2025 ; Xu et al., 2025 ) ; our tasks come from a proposer rewarded for intermediate judged completion, our transitions are predicted, and a second stage adds an adversary.
paragraphs.zh: 在网页世界模型中进行学习。继《World Models》（Ha 和 Schmidhuber，2018）之后，WMA 和 WebDreamer 使用网页世界模型进行规划（Chae 等人，2025；Gu 等人，2024），WebEvolver 将其与策略一同训练（Fang 等人，2025），而 DreamGym 则在一个经验模型中在线训练策略，并测试其向真实环境的迁移能力（Chen 等人，2026b）；我们直接沿用 WebWorld 的预测页面（Xiao 等人，2026），并加入了提议者、由评判者生成的奖励以及对抗阶段。WebRL 是最接近浏览器执行循环的方法，它从失败的尝试中生成任务，并使用一个学习到的奖励模型对其进行评分（Qi 等人，2025）；AgentGym-RL 和 AgentTrek 则从已执行的动作中学习（Xi 等人，2025；Xu 等人，2025）；我们的任务来自一位因中间阶段被判定为完成而获得奖励的提议者，我们的状态转移是预测得到的，并且第二个阶段增加了一个对抗方。

paragraphs.en: Adaptive task generation. Asymmetric self-play, POET, and unsupervised environment design select challenges by estimated learning potential ( Sukhbaatar et al., 2018 ; Wang et al., 2019 ; Wang et al., 2020 ; Dennis et al., 2020 ; Jiang et al., 2021 ; Parker-Holder et al., 2022 ) , and Self-Instruct, AgentGen, and SAGE generate or evolve tasks for language agents ( Wang et al., 2023 ; Hu et al., 2024 ; Yang et al., 2025 ) ; our curriculum keeps the page distribution fixed and scores each proposal by the current executor’s judged completion rate. Absolute Zero validates proposals by execution ( Zhao et al., 2025 ) , whereas our validity is judged by a model, and Section C.7 records judged completions that contradict visible arithmetic.
paragraphs.zh: 自适应任务生成。非对称自对弈、POET 和无监督环境设计通过估计学习潜力来选择挑战（Sukhbaatar 等人，2018；Wang 等人，2019；Wang 等人，2020；Dennis 等人，2020；Jiang 等人，2021；Parker-Holder 等人，2022），而 Self-Instruct、AgentGen 和 SAGE 则为语言智能体生成或演化任务（Wang 等人，2023；Hu 等人，2024；Yang 等人，2025）；我们的课程保持页面分布固定，并根据当前执行者判断的完成率对每个提案进行评分。Absolute Zero 通过执行来验证提案（Zhao 等人，2025），而我们的有效性则由模型来判断，并且第 C.7 节记录了与可见算术结果相矛盾的判断完成案例。

paragraphs.en: Security evaluation and feedback validity. Benchmarks of indirect prompt injection ( Greshake et al., 2023 ) cover documents, tools, and web agents ( Yi et al., 2025 ; Zhan et al., 2024 ; Debenedetti et al., 2024 ; Zhang et al., 2025 ; Evtimov et al., 2025 ; Li et al., 2026 ) ; AgentDojo and WASP report attacker-goal success separately from utility, whereas we report judged completion only. Learned black-box attackers optimize against a fixed target ( Wang et al., 2025b ; Chen et al., 2026a ; Yin et al., 2026 ) ; none has been run against our executors, and a fair comparison must match target access and query budget ( Zhan et al., 2025 ; Nasr et al., 2026 ; Shi et al., 2025 ) . Our training adversary sees the goal and initial page while the evaluation adversary reacts to the current page ( Section D.4 ), so we do not claim the two are equally strong. Simulated risk evaluation ( Ruan et al., 2024 ) , judge biases and self-preference ( Zheng et al., 2023 ; Panickssery et al., 2024 ) , reward over-optimization ( Gao et al., 2023 ) , and judge manipulation ( Shi et al., 2024 ) all bear on our signals, which are judged completions and paired judgments rather than independently verified outcomes.
paragraphs.zh: 安全性评估与反馈有效性。间接提示注入的基准测试（Greshake 等人，2023）涵盖了文档、工具和网页智能体（Yi 等人，2025；Zhan 等人，2024；Debenedetti 等人，2024；Zhang 等人，2025；Evtimov 等人，2025；Li 等人，2026）；AgentDojo 和 WASP 将攻击者目标的成功情况与效用分开报告，而我们仅报告经过判断的完成状态。基于学习的黑盒攻击者针对固定目标进行优化（Wang 等人，2025b；Chen 等人，2026a；Yin 等人，2026）；目前尚无任何此类攻击者针对我们的执行器进行测试，而公平的比较必须确保目标访问权限和查询预算相匹配（Zhan 等人，2025；Nasr 等人，2026；Shi 等人，2025）。我们的训练对抗方能够看到目标和初始页面，而评估对抗方则需根据当前页面做出反应（D.4 节），因此我们并不认为两者具有同等强度。模拟风险评估（Ruan 等人，2024）、判断者的偏见与自我偏好（Zheng 等人，2023；Panickssery 等人，2024）、奖励过度优化（Gao 等人，2023）以及判断者操控（Shi 等人，2024）均会影响我们的信号，而这些信号是经由判断得出的完成状态和配对判断，而非独立验证的结果。
